notes.title: Solar Sphere: Command Protocol Engaged
notes.content:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/222/gylxjt576buz9fzynytbic0.png[/img]
[h2][b][System Initialization...][/b][/h2]

Loading... Connecting to core ship network... Confirming status...

Connection established. Core directives received.

[b]Command priority:[/b] Absolute.

[b]Ship designation: [/b]Celestial Vanguard.

[b]Mission:[/b] Construction of Dyson Sphere.

[b]Status:[/b] Critical.

Energy base… unstable. Fluctuations detected.

Platform supports connection through [b]Tabletopia[/b]. Game module activated.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/222/k1pquytnfhsdk081ljctu4.png[/img]
[h2][b][Game: Solar Sphere.] [/b][/h2]

You are the captain of a spacecraft orbiting a dying sun — a last ember of warmth in a universe growing colder by the hour.

Your orders are clear: initiate and complete the construction of a [b]Dyson Sphere[/b] — the ultimate feat of engineering and hope. A colossal structure to harness the full energy of the star. Success means salvation. Failure means extinction.

But you are not alone.

Other captains, with the same mission, may assist you — or compete. You cannot predict their motives.

And beyond human factions… an alien threat looms. They view the Dyson Sphere as a violation. An intrusion.

[b]Your only tools:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dice, to generate and allocate energy.
[*] Drones, to carry out your commands.
[*] Strategy, to withstand the chaos that follows.
[/list]
[b]Error:[/b] Communication systems offline.

[b]Connection to other players:[/b] unavailable.

[b]Resources:[/b] severely limited.

[b]Countdown initiated. Time until stellar collapse:[/b] classified.

You must act. Every cycle matters. Every misstep echoes through history.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/223/28huzdc3fzu1jlva6hqwm0.png[/img]
[h2][b][Preparing for Operations…][/b][/h2]
 
[b]Resource load:[/b] 70%... Checking active drones…

[b]Drone readiness:[/b] 3 of 6 operational.

[b]Reprocessing module:[/b] available.

You begin with dice — the embodiment of volatile energy. They are not weapons, but tools. With each roll, you shape the fate of the [b]Sphere[/b]. You must channel these fragments of energy into tasks: mining, building, expanding, defending.

Drones assist in translating your dice into action — but your fleet is small. Each drone represents a lifeline. And you have too few.

[b]ERROR:[/b] Not enough drones to perform all actions.

[b]Reprocessing required.[/b]

Reprocessing dice gives you new drones. But there is always a cost: time. Lost opportunities. A weakening of momentum.

And time… is not on your side.

[b]WARNING:[/b] Enemy signals detected.

[b]Estimated arrival:[/b] imminent.

Alien resistance is mounting. Unknown entities oppose the birth of the [b]Sphere[/b]. You must now make a crucial choice:
[list]
[*] Spend resources to bolster your defenses?
[*] Or continue building and risk exposure?
[/list]
Every decision builds pressure. Every second lost is a step closer to failure.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/223/lyx393wisvvq3fbfbk7d44.png[/img]
[h2][b][Warning. Enemy Attack…][/b][/h2]
 
[b]ALERT:[/b] Perimeter breach detected.

[b]Energy system status:[/b] unstable.

[b]Defense systems:[/b] partially online.

The first wave is here.

Alien ships pierce the void. They attack not with hatred, but with conviction — to stop what they believe is a cosmic transgression.

You are the last shield between them and the future of humanity.

To defend the Sphere, you must sacrifice resources intended for construction. If you hold them off, you buy time.

If not… the entire project could collapse.

[b]ERROR:[/b] Not enough drones for effective defense.

[b]Redistribution required.[/b]

You stand at a crossroads:
[list]
[*] Delay the project and survive?
[*] Or gamble everything on pushing forward?
[/list]
[b]WARNING:[/b] Alliance with other players unavailable.

[b]You are alone.[/b]

Isolation breeds clarity… and fear.

[i]Choose wisely, Commander.[/i]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/223/cqvu4zs6lubysmv2jomyeu.png[/img]
[h2][b][Dice Reprocessed. Emergency Activation…][/b][/h2]
 
Reprocessing complete. New drones generated.

But it’s not enough.

The [b]Sphere’s[/b] systems are strained. Internal energy levels are falling. Every reprocessed die draws from your core reserves. Your hands tremble over the command interface. One more reallocation, and you might lose control altogether.

[b]ERROR:[/b] Insufficient resources for reprocessing.

[b]Critical state approaching.[/b]

Your drones scramble across the hull, rerouting power conduits and fortifying defenses. But the core trembles. It cannot take much more.

Do you prioritize defense? Do you risk another reprocessing? Or do you gamble on the final push toward construction?

[b][Alert: Energy levels critical…] [/b]Alien pressure increases. Internal alarms echo in your ears. You're bleeding time, losing options.

[b]And yet — you must keep building.[/b]

[b]You must.[/b]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/223/i92eja2lb23boz0xqkrji2.png[/img]
[h2][b][Expansion of the White Dwarf. Not Enough Drones…][/b][/h2]

[b]ALERT: [/b]Solar flare surge detected.

[b]Expansion opportunity unlocked.[/b]

The dying star pulses — a final gift. A chance to expand your reach. With corporate-sponsored tech, you can unlock new sectors of the [b]Sphere[/b] and harvest additional energy. But expansion comes with a cost.

You need robots. Not drones, not dice — but specialized AI units designed for energy harvesting. Activating them requires immense investment and energy redirection.

[b]ERROR:[/b] Robots offline.

[b]Activation protocols require full reallocation of current efforts.[/b]

Meanwhile, the enemy adapts. They strike harder, faster. The system begins to fragment. Your stabilizers blink red.

You are trapped in a loop of risk:
[list]
[*] Expand and gain strength?
[*] Or defend and delay collapse?
[/list]
One misstep, and the star collapses with your dream still unfinished.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/223/khvhyi6mzmcsqnuf1yrjwb.png[/img]
[h2][b][Final Stage. Resources Running Low…] [/b][/h2]

[b]ERROR: Energy running out.[/b]

[b]Critical failure approaching.[/b]

[b]All systems under threat.[/b]

This is it.

The last cycle. The final attempt.

The Dyson Sphere is close to completion, but your reserves are almost gone.

Drones are breaking down.

Dice are too few to reprocess.

Enemies are circling like vultures.

And the Sphere remains — incomplete.

[b]RECOMMENDATION: Initiate Final Protocols.[/b]

[b]Engage in emergency construction override.[/b]

You must sacrifice the last of your power. Every last unit of energy must be focused on finishing the project — even if that means leaving yourself defenseless.

Will you risk it all for the [b]Sphere[/b]?

[b]WARNING:[/b] No more second chances.

[b]This is your final directive.[/b]

The stars fade. Silence approaches.

Your next move decides everything.

[previewyoutube=Ok2pQZUJ3k0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b][Objective: Build the Dyson Sphere or Perish…][/b][/h2]

The final alert echoes across your command bridge. You breathe in silence, surrounded by flickering consoles and dying power cells. There are no reinforcements. No alliances. Just you, your drones, and the dream of a sphere to outshine the stars.

Will your name be remembered as the one who brought light back to humanity — or as another lost whisper in the void?

The mission is clear. The [b]Sphere[/b] awaits.

[b][Command Override Accepted.][/b]

[b][Final directive locked.][/b]

[b][Execute.][/b]
 

[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/solar-sphere][Initiate final protocol. Now on Tabletopia.][/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Tokaido: A Journey to Harmony
notes.content:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/100/spstjpjssucoxujx5vbqn0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Tokaido: A Zen Journey of Blossoms and Memories[/b][/h2]

Open the gates to ancient [b]Japan[/b] with [b]Tokaido[/b], where each move is not just a piece movement, but a meditative journey along the legendary road connecting the majestic cities of [b]Kyoto[/b] and [b]Edo (Tokyo)[/b].

Imagine yourself as a traveler, walking along picturesque paths, where every turn reveals new wonders, like pages of an ancient scroll: majestic mountain panoramas, serene temples, steaming hot springs, fragrant local cuisine, and exquisite souvenirs that preserve the spirit of Japan.

You are a traveler, collecting moments like sakura petals, to create your own garden of memories, woven from impressions, like a precious kimono, at the end of the path.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/100/fmiydzzwnjk6zxyh3ndqle.png[/img]
[h2][b]Path of Art: Where Every Step Paints a Story[/b][/h2]
 
Forget the hustle and bustle! [b]Tokaido[/b] is not a race, but a peaceful journey of contemplation, a deep immersion in a world of harmony and beauty.

Each player becomes an artist, painting their own unique picture of the journey, where each step is a brushstroke, and each impression a distinct shade of color, forming a one-of-a-kind palette of emotions. The game invites players to savor every moment, embracing the serene flow of the path, where aesthetics and strategy intertwine in an elegant dance, much like the graceful movements of a geisha.

With every decision, you craft a masterpiece that reflects your personal experience, transforming every turn into a meaningful reflection of the soul's journey. It’s a world where time slows down, and each moment is cherished, offering both tranquility and the subtle thrill of discovery.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/101/rmnsxxdk4ebdiut5r2yy45.png[/img]
[h2][b]Mechanics, Like a River's Flow[/b][/h2]

The unique [b]'linear track'[/b] is not just a road, but a river of time, where each move is a drop, carrying you to new shores, where unexplored treasures are hidden.

You choose how fast this stream flows: slowly, savoring each moment, or swiftly, outpacing other travelers to secure desired spots along the way, like a hunter pursuing elusive prey.

This creates a strategic choice where you must consider the actions of other players and their potential moves, like a chess player calculating moves several steps ahead.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/101/kl3xzj5rnjdvyn3of59on0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Every Step is a Poem: The Haiku of Travel[/b][/h2]

Along the way, you'll encounter not just actions, but small poems, revealing the beauty of [b]Japanese[/b] culture:
[list]
[*] [b]Dialogues with sages[/b] – reading ancient scrolls of wisdom, delving into the world of ancient legends and philosophical teachings, like a conversation with an enlightened monk.

[*] [b]Creating landscapes[/b] – contemplating mountain peaks and sea horizons, captured in each frame, creating picturesque canvases that capture the beauty of J[b]apanese landscapes[/b], like an artist painting from nature.

[*] [b]Tasting dishes[/b] – a gastronomic journey through Japan, where each flavor is a separate chapter, tasting traditional dishes in cozy inns, savoring the taste of Japan, like a gourmet discovering new facets of culinary art.

[*] [b]Purchasing items[/b] – collecting artifacts, holding echoes of the past, acquiring unique items that reflect the richness of [b]Japanese[/b] art and crafts, like an antiquarian discovering the secrets of the past.

[*] [b]Temple offerings[/b] – touching spiritual values, like a quiet bell's chime, temple offerings that bring spiritual satisfaction, like a pilgrim seeking enlightenment.

[*] [b]Relaxing in hot springs[/b] – cleansing the soul and body, like immersing in warm embraces, relaxing in healing waters, restoring strength, like a weary traveler finding an oasis.
[/list]
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/101/rywezjnz2czpeiulknpft0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Zen Atmosphere: Tokaido as a Tea Ceremony for the Mind[/b][/h2]

Cast aside the bustle and worries!

[b]Tokaido[/b] is a tea ceremony for the mind, where each move is a sip of fragrant drink, and each moment is contemplation of the beautiful, like meditation in a rock garden. Simple rules, elegant design, and a meditative atmosphere create a sense of calm and harmony, like the quiet melody of a flute.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/101/svxxdo3vyjiafhgmsviwx6.png[/img]
[h2][b]Stonemaier Games Edition: Artistry in Every Detail[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Embark on a solitary journey, where your opponent is a reflection of your inner self, testing your wisdom and patience, like a samurai perfecting his spirit. The [b]Solo mode[/b] allows you to embark on a solo journey along the [b]Tokaido[/b], battling two virtual opponents, like testing your skills in a duel.
 
[*] Feel in your hands not just cards and pieces, but works of art, crafted with love and attention to every detail, like holding precious stones. Enjoy the tactile sensations of premium cards and components, like feeling the touch of silk.

[*] The updated rulebook is not just an instruction, but a scroll, revealing the depth and beauty of the game, like a scroll of wisdom passed down from generation to generation. Improved rule clarity makes the game even more accessible and understandable, like an experienced mentor guiding a student.

[*] Discover Tokaido in the virtual space of [b]Tabletopia[/b], where you can travel through Japan without leaving your home, like opening a portal to another world. The digital platform [b]Tabletopia[/b] recreates the atmosphere of a real board game, like a virtual ryokan.
[/list]
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/101/9oxh6l8aa0mpcpadu2wvn1.png[/img]
[h2][b]Japanese Heritage: Tokaido – A Digital Journey Through Time[/b][/h2]

[b]Tokaido[/b] is not just a game—it's a journey through time, transporting you to the era of samurai, geisha, temples, and rock gardens, like stepping into a time machine. Walk in the footsteps of great masters, leaving their mark on this legendary road. Contemplate landscapes that inspired artists and poets, like opening ancient scrolls, holding the secrets of the past. Immerse yourself in the healing waters of hot springs, bringing harmony and tranquility, like sinking into the warm embrace of nature.

Now, thanks to the digital version on [b]Tabletopia[/b], you can experience this journey right now, without leaving the comfort of your home. The digital platform recreates the atmosphere of traveling along this legendary route, offering a seamless experience of Japanese traditions, art, and cuisine.

Play solo or with friends, savoring every moment, like becoming a participant in an ancient legend. The intuitive interface and immersive design bring the world of Tokaido to life on screen, allowing you to explore the beauty of Japan anytime, anywhere. Enjoy dishes, revel in the rich aromas of [b]Japan[/b], and collect artifacts—all with just a click.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/014/101/bpucsfgregvblnxxy4olz5.png[/img]
[h2][b]Solo Mode & Tabletopia: Travel and Seek Enlightenment Anywhere[/b][/h2]
 
The [b]Solo mode[/b] allows you to embark on a solo journey along the [b]Tokaido[/b], giving you a unique opportunity to test your skills and enjoy the game at your own pace, like a samurai honing his skills.[b] Automa[/b] acts as a companion, allowing you to delve deeper into the mechanics and atmosphere of the game, like a guide leading you along unexplored paths. 

Also in this mode, it is possible to use expansions, which significantly increases the variability of the game, like opening new chapters in an adventure book. And the digital platform [b]Tabletopia[/b] recreates the atmosphere of a real board game, giving players the ability to interact with components and perform actions, like a virtual game table.

[b]Tokaido[/b] is available on the [b]Tabletopia[/b] platform, allowing you to play it online with friends or alone, like traveling through Japan without leaving your home.

Discover a world where every step is a discovery, and every moment is art, creating a unique symphony of wanderings!

notes.title: Mars on Fire! For the Independence of the Red Planet!
notes.content:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/662/ayttdusz7za4nbg7jic4po.png[/img]
[h2][b]Open a New Chapter in Interplanetary Conflicts: Red Dust Rebellion[/b][/h2]

Are you ready to experience a legendary strategic game filled with political intrigue and interplanetary battles?

Meet [b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b], the first game from the famous [b]COIN[/b] (Counter Insurgency) series now available in digital format on [b]Tabletopia[/b]! This is a groundbreaking moment for strategy fans: now you can experience the legendary [b]COIN[/b] mechanics in digital form without leaving your home. 

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] offers a unique blend of political intrigue, thrilling battles, and deep strategic decisions, which only the [b]COIN[/b] series can offer. Now, you can immerse yourself in the world of revolutionary conflicts on Mars in an online format!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/u6p0uidjfby7spvp9mwam0.png[/img]
[h2][b]The First COIN Game on Tabletopia: Revolution on the Red Planet[/b][/h2]

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] is not just another strategy game — it is the first game from the [b]COIN[/b] series to be available on [b]Tabletopia[/b].

Inspired by one of the most popular series of board games about counterinsurgency warfare, it transports players to the future, where Mars becomes the arena for intense political and military conflicts. With the newly available digital version, [b]COIN[/b] fans can finally experience the strategic depth of this iconic series directly on [b]Tabletopia[/b] — without the need to gather complicated components or find a physical space to play. All you need is an internet connection and the desire to dive into a world of revolutionary intrigue and cosmic battles.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/1zci1yx6ne1iy5ekjapen5.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Martian Struggle for Freedom Begins[/b][/h2]

[i]"200 years of Earth’s rule. 200 years of commands from the distant blue ball in the sky. Spoiled politicians from Earth, playing golf under the warm sun, sipping French champagne, and eating grapes, dare to tell us how to live? They don’t know us because they — they are not us! We are the sons and daughters of Mars! The children of the Red Planet! We were born in red dust and say: enough with Earth's rule!"[/i] — [b]Aroha Thompson[/b], representative of [b]"Red Dust"[/b] and organizer of the [b]Mining Union[/b]. These words are a call to action for those ready to stand with those tired of Earth's oppression. 

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] takes you to the 2250s, when [b]Mars[/b] becomes the center of revolution, and its inhabitants begin their fight for independence. The future of the [b]Red Planet[/b] depends on who will win in this epic battle for freedom.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/zrt6ufdtncnqtz8xmjabbd.png[/img]
[h2][b]The World of the Game: Mars in the 2250s[/b][/h2]

The year 2250 has arrived, and the 200th anniversary of the first human colony on [b]Mars[/b] is approaching. These are two centuries of challenges and achievements. [b]Mars’s[/b] surface is a barren desert, and those who survive here have settled in vast underground cities known as Labyrinths. Life in these subterranean structures is a constant fight for survival, where every step requires effort and every decision has its consequences.

[b]Mars[/b] is not just a colony — it’s a world where everyone seeks freedom. While some want to turn [b]Mars[/b] into a mirror of Earth, with green forests and oceans, others oppose terraforming, believing it will destroy the planet’s unique ecosystem.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/qp11micdjhva1r44hmlu43.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Game Factions[/b][/h2]

In [b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b], you will choose one of several unique factions, each with its own goals, approaches, and methods. You will control one of them to lead it to victory and shape the future of the [b]Red Planet[/b].

[list]
[*] [b]Martian Transitional Government (MG):[/b] Represents the political balance between Earth’s and Mars’ interests. This faction seeks to maintain the status quo, balancing Martian protests and Earth’s demands.

[*] [b]Corporations (CORP):[/b] Resource-hungry forces dependent on Earth’s government for support. These factions fight for power and resources, but their decisions are always influenced by the political situation.

[*] [b]Red Dust Movement (RD):[/b] A faction fighting for Mars’s independence. This faction opposes Earth’s dominance and wants Mars to decide its own fate.

[*] [b]Church of Return (CR):[/b] A radical faction opposing terraforming and seeking to preserve Mars’ unique ecosystem in its natural state. These fanatical forces will do anything for their cause.
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/lxaxrzzi8cfpjycgkx1z12.png[/img]
[h2][b]Gameplay and Features[/b][/h2]
 

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] is not just a strategy game — it is a true simulation of interplanetary conflict, where you will need to make complex political and military decisions. The game combines elements of diplomacy, strategy, and tactics.

[list]
[*] [b]Hostile Environment:[/b] Dust storms block access to regions, and battles in the Labyrinths can damage infrastructure. All of this complicates the game, making you consider many factors in your strategy.

[*] [b]Unpredictable Raiders:[/b] The Church of Return acts unexpectedly, disrupting the plans of other factions and creating chaos among enemies.

[*] [b]Orbital Warfare:[/b] Satellites offer unique surveillance opportunities and hidden options for attack, opening up additional strategic possibilities.

[*] [b]Multiple Battlefields:[/b] The game features several different locations for battles, including the Labyrinths, the Gella Basin, and the plains of Arabia, each with its own unique features that affect the course of battle.

[*] [b]Flexible Logistics:[/b] Control of spaceports allows players to quickly move forces between regions, giving them strategic advantages.
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/662/zhxqrs3fmwxmxkjrncvbk1.png[/img]
[h2][b]Legendary COIN Game System[/b][/h2]

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] is the first [b]COIN[/b] game now available on [b]Tabletopia[/b], offering a unique experience with the legendary system of the series. The game emphasizes not only military actions but also political manipulation. Each faction has its own goals and resources, and your task is to plan your moves so that they lead to victory.

[list]
[*] [b]Long-term Strategies:[/b] Resources from Earth arrive slowly, which forces factions to plan their actions well in advance.

[*] [b]Territorial Control:[/b] Controlling key areas on Mars provides significant advantages, helping factions strengthen their positions and push forward their goals.

[*] [b]Dynamic Conflict:[/b] Alliances, betrayals, and unexpected attacks create constant tension, and each decision can change the course of the game
[*] 
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/663/pve0rrxenzyiux17ftu8d2.png[/img]
[h2][b]Immersion in an Epic Struggle [/b][/h2]

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] offers an exciting strategic experience set in the future, where [b]Mars[/b] fights for its independence. Strategies, diplomacy, and the struggle for resources intertwine in a dynamic conflict. Every decision you make can affect the future of the [b]Red Planet[/b]. Play as one of the factions, carve your path to victory, and create your version of [b]Mars’s[/b] future.

[h3][b]Unique Game Features[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Historical Context:[/b] The game is based on a carefully crafted science fiction story that makes it particularly engaging for fans of the genre.

[*] [b]Multilevel Mechanics:[/b] Each faction has unique abilities and strategic goals, adding variety to every game.

[*] [b]Complex Diplomatic Relations:[/b] Form temporary alliances, betray allies, or become a leader of independence by deciding who your friends and enemies are.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=l9ruesGhArQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Be Part of Mars’ History[/b][/h2]

[b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] immerses you in the atmosphere of classic science fiction, where Martian colonies, deserts, underground cities, and orbital stations become the battleground for epic struggles. This is not just a game, but an opportunity to become part of history and take part in the fight for the future of the [b]Red Planet[/b].

Join the revolution, become part of the struggle for freedom, and create your future for [b]Mars[/b]. [b]Red Dust Rebellion[/b] is not just a game; it is a chance to experience strategic depth and witness a true cosmic revolution. 

[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/red-dust-rebellion]Play Red Dust Rebellion on Tabletopia today![/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: In the Footsteps of Pioneers: A Temple Guide
notes.content:
Embark on an exciting and adventurous journey across [b]North America[/b] with brave pioneers and pilgrims! 

[b]Temple Trip[/b] is an exhilarating and dynamic board game designed for families to enjoy together. In this game, each player takes on the role of an explorer visiting important cultural and historical landmarks of [b]LDS temples[/b].

Gather your loved ones—whether it's family or friends—and prepare for an unforgettable race as you visit over [b]80 temples[/b], spanning from [b]Edmonton in Canada[/b] all the way to [b]Juarez[/b], [b]Mexico[/b], from the icy landscapes of [b]Anchorage[/b] to the tropical beauty of [b]Hawaii[/b], [b]Seattle[/b], and [b]Fort Lauderdale[/b].

[b]Temple Trip[/b] is a unique game that combines the enriching subjects of geography and history, transforming them into a thrilling adventure [b]for 2 to 10 players, ages 8 and up[/b].

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/540/zdwnlxquuwsmazpz5iuwt7.png[/img]
[h2][b]Game Features[/b][/h2]
 
The temple race begins in [b]Salt Lake City[/b], the heart of this thrilling expedition, where each player will choose a starting point and select the number of temples they need to visit—typically between 5 and 6 temples.

The ultimate goal is to be the first player to visit all their assigned temples and return to the main temple in [b]Salt Lake City[/b].

Strategic planning is essential as players need to chart their own routes while simultaneously blocking their opponents' paths! Throughout the game, players can use [b]"obstacle cubes"[/b] to create roadblocks that hinder others' progress. On top of that, the game offers different modes of travel, such as air travel or road trips, which can be activated on specific routes, adding depth and variety to the journey.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/541/0fzkpmf8zceonfjtujnwa1.png[/img]
[h2][b]How to Play[/b][/h2]

To start, decide how many temples each player will need to visit to win. Once that’s settled, place the pieces at the designated starting airports, and each player will receive a set of temple cards. You will also receive a red cube to represent roadwork and a black cube for adverse weather, which you can strategically use to create obstacles on your opponents' paths.

Each player takes turns rolling the dice to move across the board, racing against others to reach their assigned temples as quickly as possible. However, switching between travel modes—whether by car or plane—requires an additional task, so players need to plan their moves wisely to avoid delays. It’s not just about speed but also about managing your resources and keeping your opponents at bay.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/540/ilqwmuqy9frnnhssiqzhub.png[/img]
[h2][b]Amazing Route Options and Cards[/b][/h2]
 
One of the most exciting aspects of [b]Temple Trip[/b] is the variety of routes players can choose.

Each route offers unique conditions and challenges that will test the players' decision-making abilities. Some routes involve air travel, which can give you an advantage by bypassing certain obstacles, while others require border crossings that may slow you down unless you can roll the dice successfully to bypass them.

[b]Special Task[/b] cards add an extra element of surprise to the game, as they can reroute players to different cities or even send them on unexpected detours. These cards can drastically change the course of the game, forcing players to adapt their strategies on the fly. Among these cards, players may also find rare and valuable ones, like the coveted [b]"Fast Pass"[/b], which allows you to bypass certain border restrictions, giving you a significant edge over the competition.

Staying alert and making the best use of these cards can make the difference between victory and defeat.
 
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/541/snykhbmcqi89smxldr7ld4.png[/img]
[h2][b]Rewards Along the Way [/b][/h2]

Every time a player visits a temple, they flip over a card to confirm their task completion and gain rewards.

In addition to the satisfaction of marking another temple visit off the list, players can collect obstacle cubes that they can use to block the routes of other players. This adds an important tactical layer to the game: not only do players need to pick the fastest and most efficient routes, but they must also protect their paths from being disrupted by others. 

Players need to think ahead, balancing their progress with defensive tactics to ensure they don’t fall behind or lose momentum due to well-placed obstacles. 

[h3][b]Final Stretch and Victory[/b][/h3] 
Once a player has visited all their assigned temples, they can begin their final dash back to Salt Lake City.

But don’t think the race is over yet!

The other players can still use their cards to delay or reroute the leading player, making it a dramatic finish to the game. The first player to reach [b]Salt Lake City[/b] after completing their temple visits is crowned the winner and becomes the ultimate pioneer of this [b]North American adventure[/b].

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/541/owcjjyin4w4kqnvt4mx5n7.png[/img]
[h2][b]Components and Design[/b][/h2]
 
The game set includes a vibrant array of components that make [b]Temple Trip[/b] not only fun to play but also visually appealing. It features a detailed game board with city locations clearly marked, 10 colorful player markers, 16 black cubes and 16 red cubes for creating obstacles, 2 standard dice, as well as temple and task cards. There are also bonus and blank cards included, allowing players to personalize the game with their own cities and tasks, further enhancing the fun and replayability for the whole family. Whether you are a first-time player or an experienced gamer, these customizable elements make every playthrough unique and exciting.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/541/7ogs1cteoqax9u9rww6d22.png[/img]
[h2][b]Support us on Kickstarter and be part of our success![/b][/h2]
 
Join our journey to bring [b]TEMPLE TRIP[/b] to life by supporting us on [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/kandigames/temple-trip]Kickstarter[/url][/b]! By backing us, you’ll become a vital part of this exciting adventure.

[h3][b]Get Creative with Custom Cards[/b][/h3]
As a backer, you'll receive four blank ASSIGNMENT cards, one for each category color. Use them to craft your own unique challenges, adding a personal touch to your game experience. 

[h3][b]Enjoy Exclusive Benefits with Our Pledge Manager[/b][/h3] 
When you pledge, you’ll gain access to exclusive perks:
[list]
[*] [b]Late Pledges:[/b] Missed the initial deadline? No problem!
[*] [b]Expansion Pack Add-ons:[/b] Add more excitement with themed expansions.
[*] [b]Flexible Address Updates:[/b] Update your address anytime before shipping to ensure smooth delivery.
[/list]
[h3][b]Unlock Stunning Photographic TEMPLE Cards[/b][/h3]
Our [b]Expansion Packs[/b] will feature beautiful, user-submitted [b]TEMPLE photos[/b], substituting the original graphic cards. With a minimum of [b]500 pledges[/b], your very own [b]TEMPLE photos[/b] could be part of the game, creating a more personalized experience. Plus, these [b]Expansion Packs[/b] are [b]FREE[/b] for all [b]Kickstarter backers[/b] of [b]TEMPLE TRIP[/b] across all versions, including:
[list]
[*] [b]TEMPLE TRIP[/b] (Original Edition)
[*] [b]TEMPLE TRIP UT[/b] - Utah Road Trip
[*] [b]TEMPLE TRIP IE[/b] - International Edition
[/list]
[h3][b]Quick Delivery and Regular Updates[/b][/h3]
We’re committed to keeping you informed every step of the way. US backers will receive the first 1,000 copies of the original [b]TEMPLE TRIP[/b] within weeks of the campaign’s close, so you’ll be among the first to play!

Be part of [b]TEMPLE TRIP[/b] and make history with us on [b]Kickstarter[/b]!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/11995444/d1ae30e0dd3a6c66a31ac2c1a8876296a2984bac.png[/img]
[h2][b]Closing Thoughts[/b][/h2]

Temple Trip is not just a game; it's an adventure of discovery, strategy, and excitement. As you take on the role of a pioneer blazing a trail through cities and countries, you'll experience the joy of learning about new places and historical landmarks while competing against your friends and family in an engaging race to victory.

Whether you’re traveling across the vast landscapes of [b]North America[/b] or dealing with unexpected challenges along the way, every moment in this game is filled with excitement and surprises.

Travel, compete, and make every move a step toward an unforgettable adventure!

[h2][b]Unlock the Full Potential of Your Game![/b][/h2]
 
The latest expansion for [b]Apiary[/b] is not just an addition; it’s a transformative experience that significantly enriches the core game with new dimensions of strategy and excitement.

Dive into a treasure trove of components designed to seamlessly integrate with the original game, ensuring that every session feels fresh, engaging, and dynamic. New mechanics and components elevate your gameplay, presenting new challenges and opportunities. Engage in strategic showdowns as you adapt to the dynamic environment, manage resources wisely, and prepare for the looming Dearth, a critical period that tests your ability to thrive amid scarcity.

Will you seize the opportunity to flourish in this competitive landscape filled with rival factions, or will you merely survive?

Your choices will define your legacy among the stars!

Explore uncharted lands, expand your workforce, conduct groundbreaking research, and craft unique upgrades that will amplify your scoring potential and strategic capabilities. With each turn, you will be faced with critical decisions that will impact not only your strategy but the very fabric of your burgeoning civilization.

As you immerse yourself in a richly detailed world brimming with imaginative mechanics, each session promises an unparalleled experience filled with tension and excitement. Will you rise to the challenge, leading your faction to greatness, or will the vastness of space prove too overwhelming?

Your decisions will shape the fate of your faction as you navigate through intricate challenges, lead your worker bees in exploration, and unlock the secrets of ancient technology. The sweet taste of victory awaits you as you explore the enchanting cosmos and embrace the endless possibilities of this exciting expansion, allowing you to create a legacy that will echo through the ages.

With its captivating mechanics and immersive narrative, this expansion engages fans of renowned strategy games like [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/teotihuacan-city-of-gods][b]Teotihuacan[/b][/url] and [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/euphoria-build-a-better-dystopia][b]Euphoria[/b][/url].

Each session is an exhilarating blend of strategy, luck, and resource management, ensuring that no two adventures are ever the same. Are you ready to elevate your gameplay and guide your faction to glory?

Step into this new chapter of Apiary, where the future of honeybees lies in your hands!

notes.title: Experience the Thrill of Stamp Collecting with Stamp Swap!
notes.content:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/393/f1tfvwgas0cb5xqqghvti1.png[/img]

Have you ever been captivated by the intricate art, historical stories, and global connections behind stamp collecting? 

If so, then [b]Stamp Swap[/b] is the perfect game for you!

Designed by the renowned [b]Paul Salomon[/b], creator of popular games, [b]Stamp Swap[/b] takes you on a thrilling journey through the timeless hobby of philately (stamp collecting) and turns it into an exciting, strategic board game experience you can share with family and friends. Whether you’re a seasoned collector or new to the world of stamps, this game offers a fast-paced and fun way to immerse yourself in a unique collecting adventure.


[h2]Why Stamp Collecting?[/h2]

Stamp collecting is a hobby steeped in history, art, and culture. For decades, enthusiasts have been drawn to the diversity of designs, stories, and significance that each stamp represents. From rare historical stamps to modern commemorative issues, the world of stamps is as vast as it is fascinating.

[b]Stamp Swap[/b] pays homage to this beloved pastime, making it accessible, competitive, and fun for everyone—while keeping the spirit of collecting at its heart. It's a celebration of the beauty and storytelling of stamps while adding the thrill of strategy to the mix.


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/476/8sqzkgrskmws38kxs38k91.png[/img]

[h2][b]Game Overview:[/b][/h2]
 
In [b]Stamp Swap[/b], players compete over the course of three engaging rounds, each of which is filled with drafting, trading, organizing, and optimizing their personal collection of stamps.

But this isn’t just about grabbing as many stamps as you can—it’s about carefully curating your collection to match the most valuable, rare, and strategically important stamps.

With a mix of strategy, negotiation, and luck, every choice you make could bring you one step closer to victory.


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/453/vyc0yyzwigfxvzx7jkk9zm0.png[/img]

[h2][b]How to Play:[/b][/h2]
 

[b]Stamp Swap[/b] revolves around three key phases each round, where players will need to balance strategy, risk, and reward. The gameplay is designed to be simple enough for beginners to pick up, yet deep enough for seasoned board gamers to sink their teeth into.
 
[list]
[*] [b]Draft & Collect:[/b] The round begins with players drafting from a selection of tiles laid out on the table. Some tiles are face-up, allowing you to see exactly what you’re getting, while others remain face-down, adding an element of surprise. These tiles represent the stamps you’ll collect, along with bonus cards that can enhance your strategy. The tension lies in choosing between taking a known value or gambling on hidden treasures—some of which could include rare gold-foil stamps that can earn you big points.

[*] [b]Divide & Choose:[/b] Once the drafting is complete, players are faced with a crucial decision—divide your collected tiles into two groups. You’ll offer one group to another player, while keeping the other for yourself. It’s a test of judgment and strategy: do you keep the better set of stamps for yourself, or offer it to manipulate your opponent’s choices? The stakes are high, and clever decisions in this phase can make all the difference in the final score.

[*] [b]Score & Organize:[/b] At the end of each round, players will score points based on a set of predetermined goals. These goals vary from round to round, but they might include collecting stamps from specific regions, completing themed sets, or acquiring the rarest stamps available. Each goal can only be scored once, so you'll need to plan ahead and focus on completing your collection before others beat you to it. With three rounds in total, the player who scores the most points by the end of the game is declared the winner, earning the prestigious title of [b]Master Philatelist[/b]!
[/list]


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/452/qcuebdrvdy5t59zjpglat5.png[/img]

[h2][b]Features You’ll Love:[/b][/h2]
 
[list]
[*] [b]Strategic Depth and Replayability:[/b] No two games of [b]Stamp Swap[/b] are ever the same. The combination of drafting, dividing, and scoring objectives creates a wealth of strategic options, ensuring that every decision counts. As the game evolves over three rounds, you'll need to adapt to new challenges and stay one step ahead of your opponents to win.

[*] [b]Stunning Components and Design:[/b] Featuring beautifully illustrated stamp tiles, the game evokes the elegance of real-world philately. Each tile is meticulously crafted, showcasing both classic and modern stamp designs. The rare gold-foil stamps add a luxurious touch, elevating the overall aesthetic and making the game a visual delight.

[*] [b]Accessible yet Challenging:[/b] [b]Stamp Swap’s[/b] rules are easy to learn, making it a fantastic choice for casual gamers and experienced board game enthusiasts alike. Its blend of simple mechanics and rich strategy means players of all skill levels can jump in and enjoy. Whether you're playing with friends at a game night or introducing younger family members to the joys of collecting, [b]Stamp Swap[/b] has something for everyone.

[*] [b]Solo Mode and Multiplayer Options:[/b] Want to test your stamp-collecting skills solo? [b]Stamp Swap[/b] offers a solo mode where you can challenge yourself against a tough AI opponent, making it the perfect companion for solo gamers. And when you’re ready for a full multiplayer experience, the game supports up to five players, providing a competitive yet friendly atmosphere for group play.

[*] [b]Collecting Meets Competition:[/b] [b]Stamp Swap[/b] masterfully blends the joy of stamp collecting with the thrill of competition. As you draft, trade, and organize your collection, you’ll be constantly thinking about how to outwit your opponents, while also enjoying the satisfaction of building a unique and valuable set of stamps.
[/list]


[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/452/kmifwnigt1yguzaifh7zca.png[/img]

[h2][b]Unforgettable Moments Await in Stamp Swap[/b][/h2]
 
In conclusion, [b]Stamp Swap[/b] is not just a board game; it is an exciting journey into the world of stamp collecting that combines strategy, art, and captivating historical narratives. The game offers a unique opportunity to immerse yourself in the rich and diverse realm of philately, where every decision holds significant importance.

One of the key features of [b]Stamp Swap[/b] is its ability to maintain interest over many gaming sessions.

Each round is filled with unexpected twists and strategic choices, making every game unique. Players can adapt their approaches depending on the situation, competing for rare and valuable stamps, which ensures high replayability. This game also develops critical thinking and strategic planning skills, making it a valuable activity, not just entertainment.

Moreover, [b]Stamp Swap[/b] provides players the chance to evaluate risks and make decisions based on limited resources, which can be very beneficial both in the game and in life.


[previewyoutube=Xn6I8hboxyo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Play with your loved ones![/b][/h2]
 
So gather your friends and family, as [b]Stamp Swap[/b] is not just a game about stamps; it is a collection of unforgettable moments and vibrant experiences. By delving into the world of collecting, you will discover numerous stories behind each stamp. Get ready for strategic battles, friendly negotiations, and the joy of building your unique collection!

[b]Stamp Swap[/b] awaits you to deliver unforgettable experiences and new connections in the world of philately.


[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/stamp-swap]Play it now on Tabletopia[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Knitting Circle: Cozy Up with Cats, Creativity, and Competitive Fun!
notes.content:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/424/ijaes25eswmletkhghvyq3.png[/img]
From the acclaimed creators of [b]Calico[/b], [b]Cascadia[/b], and [b]Verdant[/b] comes a brand-new game that’s bound to warm your heart: [b]Knitting Circle[/b]!

Perfect for cozy gatherings and family game nights, this standalone tile-laying adventure combines the joy of crafting, the fun of puzzles, and the charm of cats.

Whether you’re young or young at heart, [b]Knitting Circle[/b] invites you into a delightful world where yarn, buttons, and your feline friends help you create the most beautiful garments imaginable.

[h2][b]Weave Creativity into Every Move[/b][/h2]

In [b]Knitting Circle[/b], you’re not just knitting—you're crafting something truly unique.

As passionate knitters, players gather vibrant yarn to weave intricate patterns and create the warmest, most stylish garments.

But it’s not just about speed!

The secret to winning lies in mastering the art of color coordination and matching your patterns to ever-changing scoring goals. Every round presents fresh challenges, making every move a mix of creativity and clever strategy.

And let’s not forget the star of the show: your helpful feline companion!

These adorable cats use their [b]"grabby paws"[/b] to help you pick the perfect yarn from the central basket, adding a playful twist to each turn and a dash of surprise to your strategy.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/428/fth5cjcngn2krr1t2fabi1.png[/img]
[h2][b]Easy to learn, but truly captivating to master[/b][/h2]
 
With simple mechanics, [b]Knitting Circle[/b] is designed for players of all skill levels—from kids to grandparents!

Each round is broken into two engaging phases: collect yarn and knit garments. In the first phase, players move around the [b]Knitting Circle Board[/b], choosing from an array of colorful yarn tiles to gather the perfect materials. In the second phase, they use these tiles to complete their garment patterns, ensuring that every stitch matches the needed colors and patterns on their garment cards.

[h3][b]But don’t be fooled by its simplicity![/b][/h3]
 
Beneath the cozy exterior lies a rich puzzle game, where players must balance smart decisions, pattern matching, and bonus objectives to come out on top. 

Whether you're a casual gamer or a seasoned puzzle enthusiast, [b]Knitting Circle[/b] offers endless replayability and fresh challenges with every game.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/428/qzpgyxbnwiubjwrnxhjlr7.png[/img]
[h2][b]A New Puzzle Every Time You Play[/b][/h2]
 
One of [b]Knitting Circle’s[/b] most exciting features is its endless variety.

With dozens of unique garment cards and variable scoring goals, no two games are the same. The random draw of yarn tiles and shifting objectives ensures every session feels brand new, keeping players on their toes and their strategies evolving.

Gather friends and family, and enjoy a game that delivers laughter, creativity, and friendly competition. It’s not just about crafting garments—it’s about creating cherished moments that last.

notes.title: Split the Hoard: The Ultimate Battle for Epic Treasure and Glory!
notes.content:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/362/zm5vjjhsmuqytpfu7buqz5.png[/img]
[h3][b]Imagine this: the dragon is slain[/b][/h3]

Its colossal body still smolders in the background, but your eyes are fixed on something far more enticing—the dragon’s legendary hoard.

Mountains of glittering gold, priceless jewels, enchanted artifacts… it’s all here, piled high as far as the eye can see.

Yet, as a seasoned adventurer, you know that wealth is only part of the reward.

True victory lies in claiming the rarest treasures and earning titles that bards will sing of for centuries.

Welcome to [b]Split the Hoard[/b], an immersive, fast-paced card game for 2-5 adventurers. In just 20 minutes, you’ll be engaged in an intense game of strategy as you try to outwit and outmaneuver your fellow adventurers.

It’s not just about grabbing gold, but making sure what you walk away with is more valuable, more legendary, and more powerful than anything anyone else can lay claim to.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/362/wqrsoe2qzkvsakwnyxmny8.png[/img]
[h3][b]The Story:[/b][/h3]

The mighty dragon has been vanquished, but your journey isn’t over. Standing amidst a vast cavern filled with untold riches, you and your companions face one final challenge: who gets what?

Bruised and battered from the fight, you know you can't linger long. An army of scavengers is on the way, eager to take the hoard for themselves.

Every second counts as you sift through piles of treasures, desperately searching for the items that will make your legacy unforgettable.

Will you claim the treasures that align with your secret agendas?

Will your haul win you the most glorious titles, or will someone else walk away with the honor that could have been yours?

[h3][b]How to Play:[/b][/h3]

Split the Hoard is played over a series of strategic rounds. Each round involves three key phases:

1.[b] Reveal[/b] – Search the dragon’s hoard for new treasures. Players draw treasure cards, unveiling priceless artifacts, gold, and special items that could help secure their legacy.

2. [b]Negotiate [/b]– This is where things get interesting. Players take turns negotiating deals, stealing from each other, or cutting temporary alliances to secure the most valuable loot. Bluffing, trading, and making deals are key to getting what you need—and preventing others from doing the same.

3. [b]Claim[/b] – Add the treasures you've successfully claimed to your haul. But be careful: the treasures you add now could make you a target in the next round.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/362/ztzcaxnxpx9yff8mjkcwf2.png[/img]
[h3][b]The Race to Glory:[/b][/h3]

The game ends when the treasure is empty - when there is nothing left to take.

But the real test comes during the final scoring. It’s not enough to simply collect gold.

Players score points based on the treasures they’ve acquired, their secret agendas, and the impressive titles they’ve won throughout the game.

Public titles are awarded for achieving visible objectives, like collecting sets of certain treasures.

But hidden personal titles are where the real strategy lies, offering unique bonuses if you can fulfill your secret goals.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/362/biyxwk8schf9bfwssywm67.png[/img]
[h3][b]Key Features of the Game:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Hidden Agendas: Each adventurer has secret objectives that guide their strategy. Will you focus on gathering artifacts, amassing gold, or securing magical items? Only you know—and that keeps everyone else guessing.

[*] Negotiation and Bluffing: The game’s heart lies in its negotiation mechanics. Will you make a deal to share treasures, or will you bluff and backstab your way to victory? The choice is yours, but beware: betrayals have consequences!

[*] Set Collection and Victory Points: Gathering treasures isn’t just about wealth; it’s about assembling the right combinations of loot to maximize your score. Whether you’re collecting rare magical items or piling up gold coins, every decision impacts your final points.

[*] Fast-Paced Rounds: Each round is quick but packed with strategic depth. Players must think on their feet, react to shifting alliances, and make tough choices in a limited time frame.
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/362/vv7z66cw6jviqymu2bksvf.png[/img]
[h3][b]The Final Showdown:[/b][/h3]

As the game reaches its climax, the pressure mounts. The treasure dwindles, and every decision feels more critical than the last.

Do you secure that last rare artifact for yourself or sabotage your rival's plans?

Do you reveal your full hand of treasures, or keep some cards close to your chest for a surprise victory?

When the last card is drawn, it’s time to see who truly made the most of their opportunity. Points are tallied from your collected treasures, public titles, and secret agendas.

The adventurer with the highest score claims not only the hoard but also eternal glory. 

[h3][b]Why Play Split the Hoard?[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] Quick and Exciting: A full game lasts just 20 minutes, making it perfect for game night or quick sessions between other adventures.

[*] Endless Replayability: With different adventurers, secret agendas, and treasures in each game, no two rounds of Split the Hoard are ever the same. You’ll keep coming back, discovering new strategies and ways to outwit your friends.

[*] Interactive Gameplay: This isn’t a game where you sit back and watch others play. Every turn involves active participation—negotiating deals, forming alliances, and making big plays to control the outcome.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=2hzB7c0XSGE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Who Will Love This Game?[/b][/h3]

If you enjoy games that involve strategy, bluffing, and negotiation, Split the Hoard is for you.

Fans of fantasy, treasure hunting, and classic adventuring tropes will especially love the game’s theme.

But even if you’re new to fantasy games, the fast-paced, engaging mechanics of Split the Hoard will quickly draw you in.

Whether you’re playing with friends or family, the interactive nature of the game makes every round an adventure.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/364/7xwo50gtisq077q0e3w8x3.png[/img]
[h3][b]Support Our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/enworld/split-the-hoard]Kickstarter[/url] and Get Instant Access![/b][/h3]

At [url=https://enpublishingrpg.com/pages/board-games-coming-soon][b]EN Publishing[/b][/url], we’ve mastered the art of delivering rewards fast and reliably. With over 40 successful Kickstarters under our belt, we’ve earned the trust of our backers, and we’re ready to exceed your expectations again.

Why wait when you can start playing right away? The moment our campaign ends, you’ll get immediate access to your digital rewards—printable files and game materials—delivered straight to your inbox. No delays, no waiting. Just pure, instant fun!

Plus, all backers enjoy free, exclusive access to online board game simulations. You’ll be able to dive into the game before the ink even dries on the printed copies.

Don’t miss out! Join our campaign, back us today, and be the first to experience the excitement.

[b]The adventure starts now—let’s play[/b]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/362/qgougzzaydnvsofemxciyv.png[/img]
[h3][b]The Dragon May Be Dead, But the Real Battle Has Just Begun…[/b][/h3]

In Split the Hoard, every decision matters.

Wealth, power, and glory are within your reach, but only if you play your cards right.

Gather your friends, shuffle your deck, and prepare for an adventure unlike any other.

It’s time to divide the treasure—and the race for riches has just begun!

notes.title: Fate of Witches: Master Dark Magic, Build Your Coven, Seize Power!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/11995444/ed032523154b82f4f0844c5d404c9cba40107810.png[/img]
In the cursed village of [b]Black Hollow[/b], the night is thick with fear, and the air smells of burning wood and flesh.

The [b]Grand High Witch[/b], ruler of the secretive [b]Council of Witches[/b], has mysteriously perished. Her death has left a power vacuum, and the witches are now locked in a bitter struggle, each vying to be her successor. But only one can claim the title of [b]Grand High Witch[/b], and the path to victory is fraught with peril. As villagers whisper of dark omens and strange disappearances, panic spreads like wildfire. The [b]Witch Hunter[/b], armed with ruthless conviction and aided by his loyal [b]Hound[/b], is on the prowl. No witch is safe.

In this world of treachery, dark magic, and blood oaths, you must rise above the others. As a powerful head witch, you are tasked with building the most formidable coven, securing forbidden relics, and mastering ancient spells. But the [b]Witch Hunter's[/b] eyes are everywhere, and betrayal lurks in the shadows.
 
Will you be the one to seize power and reign supreme, or will your dreams of grandeur turn to ash?
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/388/rrkrjy02leksdotkvazz5d.png[/img]
Welcome to [b]Fate of Witches[/b] —a chilling, strategic card game where dark forces collide and survival is anything but guaranteed.

[h2][b]A Race Against Time and Suspicion[/b][/h2]
 
In [b]Fate of Witches[/b], players take on the role of ambitious witches, each attempting to build the most powerful coven in the village while evading the deadly [b]Witch Hunter[/b].

The game is played over several rounds, with each player recruiting strange and powerful characters, collecting magical items, and casting dark spells to gain an advantage. Every decision is a risk, and one wrong move could end in capture, trial, or worse—execution by fire.

The tension rises as the [b]Witch Hunter[/b] moves through the village, uncovering secrets and hunting down anyone suspected of practicing witchcraft. 

Will you have the wits and cunning to outsmart him? 

Will your rivals sabotage your plans, or will they fall prey to their own ambition?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/388/y7jxcjtt9jtzhajplgvunc.png[/img]
[h2][b]Strategize, Sacrifice, and Survive[/b][/h2]
 
In [b]Fate of Witches[/b], strategy is key.
 
The game features a dynamic coven-building system, where you’ll need to carefully select which characters to recruit to your side.
 
Each character comes with unique abilities and attributes that can drastically change the flow of the game. Some characters can be sacrificed, unlocking dark powers in the Graveyard that can turn the tide in your favor. But beware—each sacrifice comes with a cost, and the path to victory is paved with the bones of your fallen allies.

As you recruit more witches to your coven, you'll also gather mystical items and tokens that can boost your score or enhance your abilities.
 
Magical artifacts such as enchanted cauldrons, cursed amulets, and forbidden tomes can give you the upper hand, but only if you use them wisely.
 
Timing is everything, and knowing when to cast a spell or perform a ritual can be the difference between triumph and downfall.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/388/xwyd7sovry4zkwhvyjgtf5.png[/img]
[h2][b]The Power of Sacrifice[/b][/h2]

Not all cards are meant to last.

In the world of [b]Fate of Witches[/b], power often requires sacrifice. Some of the most powerful abilities in the game are unlocked by sending your witches to the [b]Graveyard[/b]. When a character is sacrificed, they flip over, revealing their [b]Graveyard[/b] value and unlocking new powers. Their Blessed or Cursed tokens also flip, altering their effect and potentially swinging the game in your favor. This mechanic adds a grim layer of strategy to the game—sometimes, the only way forward is to betray those who serve you.

By sacrificing characters, you not only increase your score but also open new pathways to powerful combos.
 
Each decision to sacrifice must be weighed carefully—will the short-term gain be worth the long-term cost?
 
Will the dark magic unleashed by your sacrifice propel you to victory, or will it mark the beginning of your downfall?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/388/puhlbkaamegglmyfyk1re0.png[/img]
[h2][b]Build Your Coven, Build Your Power[/b][/h2]
 
[b]Fate of Witches[/b] revolves around its unique engine-building mechanics. Players draft characters from the Village Deck, each with distinct abilities—some excel in spells, others in stealth or force.

Balancing your coven’s strengths is essential for victory. As the game progresses, powerful combos emerge, giving you the upper hand or shielding you from the [b]Witch Hunter’s[/b] pursuit. Along the way, gather magical items like the Enchanted Cauldron or Witch’s Amulet, but be cautious—each item has a cost.

A Village on Edge Tension fills the game’s atmosphere, with the [b]Witch Hunter[/b] constantly on your trail.

Each round presents new threats and opportunities through the Night Event Deck, which adds unpredictability. Will you find aid or face a deadly curse? As suspicion grows, the [b]Witch Hunter[/b] draws closer, forcing every move to be more critical.

[h3][b]Endless Replayability and Strategic Depth[/b][/h3]
 
With 60 unique cards, every game is different, offering endless challenges and strategies. The drafting mechanic and changing events keep players on edge. Easy to learn but hard to master, [b]Fate of Witches[/b] promises an engaging experience for all players, whether solo or with friends.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/389/edxbdexjhin6xt7n2gcqz6.png[/img]
[h2][b]The [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fate-of-witches-game/fate-of-witches-card-game]Kickstarter[/url] Journey[/b][/h2]

[b]Fate of Witches[/b] is more than just a game—it's a passion project years in the making. And now, through [b]Kickstarter[/b], we have the opportunity to share it with the world. We’ve chosen [b]Kickstarter[/b] to ensure that we can bring this game to life with the highest possible quality. As a small indie team, we rely on the support of our backers to make this vision a reality.

From the moment you pledge, you’re not just buying a game—you’re helping us craft a complete experience, from the meticulously hand-drawn artwork to the finely tuned mechanics. We’ve chosen not to include stretch goals because we are committed to delivering the best version of [b]Fate of Witches[/b] right from the start, without compromising on quality. 

Your support means everything, and to show our gratitude, all backers will receive a free 10-card micro-expansion called [b]Witch's Runes[/b], introducing new gameplay elements to further enhance your dark journey.

[b]Kickstarter[/b] allows us to reach a global audience, connecting players from all over the world who share our love for dark, strategic games. With your help, we can bring [b]Fate of Witches[/b] into your hands—and together, we’ll raise the stakes of what an indie game can achieve.

[previewyoutube=K8nwgAw4koM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b]Are You Ready to Embrace the Darkness?[/b][/h2]

In [b]Fate of Witches[/b], survival demands cunning.

Will you sacrifice allies, harness dark power, and evade the [b]Witch Hunter[/b], or fall victim to your own ambition?

Back us now and claim your place as the [b]Grand High Witch[/b]—if you dare.

[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fate-of-witches-game]Play it now on Tabletopia[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Welcome to the exciting adventure of building your very own mining town!
notes.content:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/351/yukud6mcywsgrj949pirr1.jpg[/img]
In [b]Minecart Town[/b], a board game for 1-4 players, you will lead a group of settlers who have ventured into untamed lands in search of a safe and prosperous home.
 
Surrounded by raw resources, it's up to you to turn this barren land into a thriving city with a bustling transportation network!
 
[h3][b]The primary goal of the game[/b][/h3]
 
Is to earn the most victory points by skillfully managing resources, constructing buildings, and laying down railways to transport valuable minerals. Every decision is a step towards building an even more productive supply chain. Over the course of 4 rounds, your small settlement can blossom into a bustling town!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/351/noqx1uh5dy1mlk0shfhxd7.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Key Features:[/b][/h3]
 
Unique city-building mechanics: Construct buildings that will generate the resources you need and connect them with railroads. Efficient transportation planning is the key to success!
 

Efficiency is everything: You’ll need to carefully allocate limited resources and plan each move to maximize your efficiency. Will you focus on building new structures, or improve your existing transport routes?
 

Endless combinations: With 78 unique building tiles, no two games will be the same. Showcase your strategic brilliance by creating clever combinations and optimizing resource flow!
 

Fast-paced gameplay: Most actions take place simultaneously, keeping the game fast and engaging. Plan ahead and race toward victory!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/351/ovrnhkj6qk2pkomraplef0.png[/img]
[h3][b]Each round consists of several phases:[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Resource production[/b]: Your buildings generate vital resources like wood, stone, coal, and more.

[*] [b]Construction[/b]: Use your resources to build new structures and expand your settlement.

[*] [b]Railway planning[/b]: Design rail routes to link your buildings and ensure resource delivery.

[*] [b]Resource transportation[/b]: Without proper rail connections, resources cannot be transported between buildings.

[*] [b]Resource processing[/b]: Move resources along your railways to convert them into victory points.
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/354/u7kzyqhdyte0kuxpo5jqj3.png[/img]
[b][h3]In Minecart Town, planning is everything.[/h3][/b]
 
Each round brings you closer to the final phase, where your transportation and production system will run at full capacity.
 
By the end, you'll witness the exciting payoff of a well-executed plan, with chain reactions of efficient deliveries leading to victory.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/357/x3zqhgujbtzrj1cbrsjw80.png[/img]
[b][h3]What’s New in This Version?[/h3][/b]
 
Minecart Town is a reimagined version of the original My Trolley Town, developed in collaboration with Studio GG and JELLY JELLY GAMES.

We've revamped and enhanced the game to make it accessible to players worldwide.
 
[b]Here are the key improvements:[/b]
 
[list]
[*] Brand-new artwork by Sai Beppu;

[*] More building tile options for varied strategies;

[*] A new solo mode that lets you explore the depths of the game on your own;

[*] Streamlined setup and endgame, making gameplay quicker and more convenient;

[*] Upgraded components and revised rules for smoother play.
[/list]

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/357/cptf3skzlqsqyhvgzsjfi6.png[/img]
In [b]Minecart Town[/b], you have the ultimate chance to put your strategic thinking to the test as you build the dream town your settlers have longed for.
 
With a vast array of development possibilities, each game offers fresh opportunities to experiment with unique building combinations, crafting a town that runs like a well-oiled machine.
 
Every choice—whether it’s prioritizing resources, constructing vital railroads, or aligning your buildings for maximum efficiency—carries significant weight and will shape the future of your town.
 
You’ll have to balance immediate needs with long-term goals, ensuring that your town not only thrives but flourishes.
 
As you carefully lay each tile and map out the perfect system, the satisfaction of seeing your strategic plans come to life makes every moment both exciting and rewarding.
 
Every game is a new chance to push your creativity and decision-making skills to their fullest potential.

notes.title: Step Into the Shoes of a Ruthless Mob Boss in 1920s Manhattan!
notes.content:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/ypbkz6xe1fkpzdfsrhejve.png[/img]
The Roaring Twenties are calling it's time for you to answer as a cunning, ruthless mob boss in [b]Speakeasy[/b].

This thrilling borough control game takes you to the heart of Prohibition-era Manhattan where you'll build your empire, make deals, and fight for control of the city's lucrative underground liquor trade.

Think you've got what it takes?

[b][h3]Welcome to Prohibition-era Manhattan[/h3][/b]

The year is 1921. The United States is dry, but in Manhattan, the booze is flowing – if you know where to look. Behind closed doors, hidden from the prying eyes of law enforcement, speakeasies thrive.

As one of the most notorious mob bosses in the city, you have big plans for your operation.

[h3][b]What is your mission?[/b][/h3]

Dominate the underground liquor business, expand your influence across the city, and earn the respect of none other than Lucky Luciano, the kingpin who controls Manhattan’s entire organized crime network.

But success won’t come easy.

Every move you make is risky, and every rival gangster is vying for the same power.

In Speakeasy, you’ll need more than brute force to prevail – you’ll need subtle strategy, smooth negotiations, and a willingness to get your hands dirty.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/cd9y3ll6exzzslt0viom44.png[/img]
[h3][b]Build Your Empire, One Speakeasy at a Time[/b][/h3]

In Speakeasy, you’re more than just a gangster – you’re the boss of a growing criminal enterprise.

The game combines worker placement, map management, and territory control mechanics to create a deep strategic experience where every decision matters.

Whether you’re opening new Speakeasies, upgrading your operations into swanky nightclubs and casinos, or strategically taking over rival territories, you’ll always be working toward one goal: to become the most powerful mob boss in Manhattan.

Your journey begins with a small speakeasy tucked away in one of Manhattan’s many neighborhoods. From there, you’ll expand – setting up more operations, producing and distributing illegal alcohol, and making strategic upgrades that will help you grow your wealth and influence.

You’ll have to manage your resources carefully to ensure you have enough booze to keep your customers happy and enough thugs to protect your territory.

Play Smart or Play Dirty – The Choice is Yours!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/tnfnaqym6mlx9wx81q1hj1.png[/img]
[h3][b]Speakeasy offers you endless possibilities to build your empire[/b][/h3]

Will you play fair, stay under the radar, and quietly outsmart your opponents?

Or will you take a more aggressive approach, raiding rival gangsters, robbing rumrunners, and striking fear into the hearts of your enemies?

You will need to hire thugs to help protect your bars and do your dirty work. These loyal soldiers can be strategically placed to protect your buildings, or used to raid your competitors' operations, stealing their valuable resources and weakening their position.

But be careful - the attacks do not go unnoticed, and there is always the possibility of revenge.

Do you have what it takes to hold your ground?

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/wjjbsw5fvjlxihesp21c91.png[/img]
[h3][b]Build Alliances, But Trust No One [/b][/h3]

In Speakeasy, you're not alone.

Rival mob bosses, each with their own ambitions, fight for control of Manhattan's boroughs.

Sometimes, a strategic alliance can be your ticket to success, allowing you to take down a more powerful rival or expand into a lucrative new area.

But trust is a rare commodity in the criminal underworld, and alliances can quickly turn sour.

Be prepared to betray your allies when the time comes, and make sure you're not double-crossed.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/h38nklszoyrjbbhfidrs75.png[/img]
[h3][b]Outsmart the Law and Lucky Luciano[/b][/h3]

As your empire grows, so will your reputation.

But be careful – success attracts attention. 

The cops are always on the lookout for illegal liquor operations, and the more you expand, the more likely you are to fall under their radar. 

You’ll need to bribe law enforcement to keep your operations running smoothly, but even then, one wrong move could destroy your entire empire.

And it’s not just the law you have to worry about.

Lucky Luciano, the mob boss who controls all of Manhattan, is keeping a close eye on you. 

He expects his share of the profits, and if you fail, you could be in big trouble.

Keeping Luciano happy is crucial to your survival – disappoint him, and he won’t hesitate to send his goons to stop you. 

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/ga9q8s7sd2pvcmjfgzrg50.png[/img]
[h3][b]Rise to the Top or Fall to the Bottom[/b][/h3]

In the cutthroat world of Prohibition-era Manhattan, there’s only one path to victory: money and power.

As you navigate the dangerous streets of the city, your ultimate goal is to amass more wealth than any of your rivals.

Whether you earn your fortune legally or illegally, gain your empire or lose it all, do you have the cunning, strategy, and ruthlessness to outlast your competitors?

[url=https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/342/hngzm3fiskqc3qszk6vhza.png][img][/img][/url]
[h3][b]Key Features of Speakeasy:[/b][/h3]

Worker Placement & Card Management:
Carefully manage your resources and workers to expand your speakeasy empire while staying ahead of the competition.

Area Control:
Battle for dominance over Manhattan’s lucrative districts, strategically taking over rival territories to grow your influence.

Goons & Mobsters:
Hire goons to defend your buildings or attack rival operations, and form alliances with other mob bosses to gain the upper hand.

High Stakes:
As your empire grows, so does the risk. Bribe cops to stay off your trail, keep Luciano happy, and fend off rival attacks as you rise to power.

Immersive Theme:
Step into the gritty world of 1920s Manhattan, where speakeasies, mobsters, and jazz rule the streets.

[previewyoutube=ZRapbkjEfvU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Can You Rule Manhattan?[/b][/h3]

Speakeasy is more than just a game—it's a thrilling journey into the dark, dangerous world of Prohibition-era organized crime.

With every turn, you'll make critical decisions that could make or break your empire.

Will you rise to the top of the criminal underworld, or will you be crushed by your rivals?

The Roaring Twenties await you—grab your fedora, pour yourself a glass of the finest (illegal) booze, and get ready to take on the challenge of a lifetime.

It's time to make your mark on Manhattan in Speakeasy.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/eaglegryphon/speakeasy-1][h3][b]Unisciti all'entusiasmante campagna Kickstarter![/b][/h3][/url]

[h3][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/speakeasy]Play it now on Tabletopia[/url][/b][/h3]

notes.title: Rolling Realms Redux – Your Ticket to a World of Endless Strategy and Fun!
notes.content:
[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/308/chftk3qxs2znipfowzx3p1.png[/img]
Discover [b]Rolling Realms Redux[/b], a unique game where players compete to become the best by collecting as many stars as possible over three thrilling rounds.
 
This game offers exciting mini-games, and each playthrough presents a new set of challenges, thanks to 12 unique “realms,” each with its own opportunities and rewards.
 
It’s not just a game—it’s an adventure with dice and markers, where you’ll actively record results and use them to claim victory.
 
[b][h3]Core Gameplay Mechanics: [/h3][/b]
At the start of each turn, one player rolls two dice. The results can be used by all players to activate different realms on their cards, generate resources, and earn stars.
 
Every turn provides unique action opportunities, where each decision you make could be crucial in your quest for victory.
 
Three rounds of intense moments and surprising strategies await, and only the player with the most stars will triumph!

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/319/dp7g3rgtctjiwzxb1y8yv0.png[/img]
[h3][b]What Makes Rolling Realms Redux Special?[/b][/h3]
 
One of the unique features of this game is the carefully designed box—it’s specifically made to fit all realms ever released!
 
We’ve meticulously calculated space for all existing and future realms, so you can be confident that your collection will always have room for new additions.
 
Plus, we continue to release promo realms that add fresh twists to the game, keeping it exciting and unpredictable.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/319/odm7vdj83uriyykyp3zosb.png[/img]
[b][h3]A New Wave of Strategic Possibilities Rolling Realms Redux[/h3][/b] 
Was born in the early days of the pandemic when many people around the world found themselves in isolation.
 
Thanks to its accessibility and flexibility, the game quickly gained popularity.
 
The game’s core is built around realms inspired by various board games, and over time, its world continued to expand through collaborations with well-known publishers and designers.
 
This edition features 12 completely new realms created exclusively for Redux, making each playthrough fresh and filled with new challenges.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/319/psoffrdzatldovivsyzshj.png[/img]
[b][h3]Game Details:[/h3][/b]
The game is designed for 1-6 players, but if you want, you can expand the number of participants to unlimited by combining multiple sets.
 

Play remotely or asynchronously, making Rolling Realms Redux ideal for virtual game nights with friends, no matter where they are.
 

Each round consists of 9 turns, where dice rolls determine how you will activate your realms, generate resources, and earn stars. A key element of the game is using resources to create additional dice and increase your chances of victory.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/319/k1yz3kgw7bywn0hyz4wx5i.png[/img]
[h3][b]Endless Replayability[/b][/h3]
 
With such a variety of realm combinations, every playthrough promises to be unique.
 
Rolling Realms Redux offers over 40,000 possible realm combinations, making the game practically infinite in its strategies and scenarios.
 
This ensures that you’ll never get bored, as each time, you’ll find new tactical approaches!
 
Expanded Game Features:
 
For those seeking even more variety and challenges, we’ve prepared special expansions.
 
The Risky Rewards mini expansion and the Beyond the Realmiverse campaign offer new paths to develop your strategy.
 
Risky Rewards adds additional resources and ways to earn stars, while Beyond the Realmiverse is a four-chapter solo campaign filled with challenges, where you’ll combine and choose realms to complete various missions.
 
Whether you’re playing solo or with friends, Rolling Realms Redux offers hours of exciting gameplay, full of unexpected twists and strategic decisions.

[img]https://f.tabletopia.com/n/013/319/mmcedwf8yfriscdezx0wi7.png[/img]
[b][h3]Solo Players' Opportunity: The RRR Ball Tournament[/h3][/b]
For those who prefer solo play, a unique tournament mode called RRR Ball was designed by renowned game creators Morten Monrad Pedersen, Karel Titeca, and Lieve Teugels.
 
In this mode, you’ll compete in a series of tournaments, trying to outscore bots and earn the title of champion. The tournament spans across five leagues, each offering different levels of difficulty, starting with the hardest—League 1—and ending with the easiest—League 5. In each league, you’ll face three bots, and your skill in using resources and strategic decisions will determine if you rise to the top.
 
How the Tournament Works:
 
Each tournament lasts five weeks, with two matches per week: one between you and a bot, and another between two bots. The results of these matches determine how many goals you score for that week.
 
A unique aspect of the tournament is that winning a match doesn’t directly benefit you—only the number of goals matters, as they affect your overall position in the tournament. At the end of the season, based on your performance, you’ll either be promoted to a higher league, stay in the current one, or be relegated to a lower league.
 
Promotion and Relegation:
 
If you score more goals than the bots, you’ll become the league champion and move up to a tougher league. If you’re already in League 1 and win, you’ll earn the title of RRR Ball Grand Champion! If your score is lower, you’ll be relegated to an easier league. After this, a new season begins, and you can start competing again with a clean slate.

[previewyoutube=5zlu2PryzKY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3][b]Why Choose Rolling Realms Redux?[/b][/h3]
 
This game is perfect for strategy lovers, where every action can dramatically change the course of the game.
 
Whether you’re playing solo, with friends, or taking part in unique tournaments, Rolling Realms Redux offers a versatile experience that will remain engaging for a long time!
 
[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/rolling-realms-redux][h3][b]Play it now on Tabletopia[/b][/h3][/url]
