notes.title: Werewolves were only the beginning of your problems... 🐺
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/736de85f155a75c47b070d430e3cf6fa4e3bc643.jpg[/img]

Silver Dagger is the fourth standalone game in the Silver series of fast and engaging card games. Designed by Ted Alspach - the creator of Ultimate Werewolf and Suburbia.

In Silver Dagger, as in the other Silver card games, everyone starts the game with five face-down cards, with everyone being able to see two cards of their choice. Cards are numbered 0-13, with the number showing how many werewolves the character on that card attracts, and each character (number) has a different special power.

[previewyoutube=NWXs8nG5ztw;full][/previewyoutube]
On a turn, you draw the top card of the deck or discard pile, then either discard it to use the power of the card (but only if it came from the deck), discard it without using the power (ditto), or replace one or more of your face-down cards with this card; you can replace multiple cards only if they bear the same number, and you must reveal the cards to prove this, being penalized if you're wrong.

Silver Dagger contains 14 new roles and abilities not seen in the previous titles, some of which allow you to strategically switch the direction of gameplay, the #4 zombie in particular! As might be expected, zombies are tough to get rid of; in game terms, you can't place them on top of the discard pile, and they need to be face up in order to pass them to the previous player. The game also includes helpful roles such as the debt collector, which subtracts a point for each card held by your opponents, and the halfling, who has the power to divide your entire score for the round in half.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/2a9eb2e876f78853d23b4fbb724b5cc3a296623d.jpg[/img]

As in other Silver games, call for a vote when you think you have the fewest werewolves circling your village. Your opponents will then have only one more chance to save themselves — or to sabotage you!

The Silver series is made to mix and match! Pick out roles to fill the 0-13 slots from Silver Amulet, Silver Bullet, Silver Coin, or this title to create your very own custom deck.

notes.title: Light the world 🔥
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/48ec6279455ef37decfdf7acc05134e33e5edf4f.jpg[/img]

New from Stefan Feld comes [i][b]Bonfire[/b][/i]!

The bonfires are sources of light, energy and warmth created by the guardians of light in order to brighten the cities on the otherwise dark planet. The residents of the cities however, took the bonfires for granted and exploited them for their personal gain. Disappointed the guardians of light retreated and let the bonfires extinguish. The citizens could no longer live in the now dark cities and were forced to leave.

[previewyoutube=AeK-PTnwcHA;full][/previewyoutube]
You are a group of gnomes living close to the cities and you also need and the light of the bonfires. Missing it now, you try yourself to visit the cities and learn how to ignite the bonfires once again: You must visit the guardians of light on their holy islands and ask for tasks to prove your good will. For each completed task, they will re-ignite one extinguished bonfire. Whoever manages to earn the greatest trust from the guardians and manages to brighten their city the most will win the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11995444/fddc4eb3442797001d602576f4e63bdd40c52041.jpg[/img]

The engine for the game are the three-coloured tiles you will be puzzling onto your player board. When you manage to place the same colours adjacent to one another, you will receive more action tiles of that specific kind. This will allow you to specialize in certain types of actions and pursue different strategies.

You can use the tiles to perform the following actions:
- Move your ship to an island
- Receive a task from an island by spending two resources
- Invite a guardian of light into your city
- Trigger a procession of guardians through your city and gain resources.
- Add a landscape tile to your city (this is where the processions take place)
- Recruit a gnome gaining a special ability or victory points
- Find support by the last bonfire, gaining portals, resources or action tiles

You will play in turn order until a fixed number of tasks has been solved, after which each player has 5 more turns. During final scoring, you will receive points for your completed tasks (the bonfires) and any improvements made there (portals, landscapes or guardians).

notes.title: The Guilds
notes.content:
Try to organise your team of workers in an attempt to turn their initial scanty resources into a thriving economic system in Key Market II.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/031/YxOM9oe9qQZZfsQT02muC0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/key-market-second-edition]Key Market II[/url][/h1][u]2-4 players; 75-105 minutes[/u]

Key Market was the sixth game in the Key series of stand-alone games published by R&D Games set in the medieval lands of Keydom, with components in both English and German. Designer David Brain and developer Richard Breese have now re-visited Key Market, adding four new guilds to the game and updating a number of the original guilds to give an even more challenging gaming experience.

tags.feature: - added four new guilds to the game and updating a number of the original guilds to give an even more challenging gaming experience.

notes.title: Tesla vs Rasputin
notes.content:
Try new interchangeable modules that can be used in various combinations in board game The Rise of Fenris, final expansion to Scythe.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/002/050/OPcVTOUzh7h9TrPjFWWFs5.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/scythe-the-rise-of-fenris]Scythe: The Rise of Fenris[/url][/h1]
[u]2-5 players; 1.5-2 hours[/u]

Empires have risen and fallen in the aftermath of the Great War, and Europa stands on the precipice of a new era. The economy is robust, morale is high, and defenses are strong. There are reports from the countryside of strange soldiers with glowing eyes, but they seem distant and harmless.

tags.feature: Try new interchangeable modules that can be used in various combinations in board game The Rise of Fenris, final expansion to Scythe.

notes.title: Deep Blue and Blazing Red
notes.content:
Connect as many exits on your board as possible in the multiplayer puzzle game Railroad Ink.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/984/tYM6roiTzdSjDEow8I3nZ4.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/railroad-ink]Railroad Ink[/url][/h1]
[u]1-6 players; 20-30 minutes[/u]

New lands have opened up and the race is on to create the best network of rail and road lines through it. In Railroad Ink, players roll the Route dice and must then draw the subsequent results on their individual Route boards.

The Deep Blue Edition brings Rivers and Lakes to the board, giving players more ways to create Routes and score points. The Blazing Red Edition challenges players with falling Meteors and erupting Volcanoes. Can players keep their Routes together amid all the carnage?

notes.title: Alternate Storyline
notes.content:
Return to the world of Anachrony and change the fate of New Earth in a new expansion!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/865/npR73QjDzDuisf5Cmlpp72.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/anachrony-fractures-of-time]Anachrony: Fractures of Time[/url][/h1]
[u]2-4 players; 1-2.5 hours[/u]

In the alternate storyline of Fractures of Time, Anachrony’s first major expansion, the four original Paths and the newly formed, sanguine Path of Unity have gained access to a powerful new technology called Flux. Flux Cores can be acquired in the Amethynia Valley, the expansion’s new main zone. By using the Flux Cores to power up their Fracture device, players may move (“Blink”) one of their already placed Exosuits to a new action space instead of placing a new one, or immediately retrieve some of their Workers or Free Action markers. This can result in never-before-seen action efficiency, but just like the Time Rifts, the Flux technology is a double-edged sword. Without a sufficiently advanced Fracture device, overusing it can cause Temporal Glitches; hectic negative effects such as shutting down the Exosuit bay slots, temporarily disabling buildings, or making players more prone to Anomalies.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/024/779/878/fdeda05d375139c9ed515e05033bcfe2_original.jpg?ixlib=rb-1.1.0&w=680&fit=max&v=1555354441&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c97a6d5257495faec084f27990437b0d[/img]

[b]Note that you can back Anachrony: Fractures of Time Expansion and Infinity Box on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/438141406/anachrony-fractures-of-time-expansion-and-infinity]Kickstarter[/url]! [/b]

notes.title: Modules of Infinity
notes.content:
Dear Tabletopians, now premium users can play such modules from [b]Anachrony: Infinity Box[/b] as Doomsday, Pioneers of New Earth and Guardians of the council. They were also added to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/869241/Tabletopia__Anachrony__Modules/]Steam DLC[/url] (so owners already have access), and the [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/anachrony]base game[/url] is free from now!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/791/hi4YTdKrilTaZGsA6yqxzA.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/anachrony-modules]Anachrony: Modules[/url][/h1][h1][u]2-4 players; 1-2.5 hours[/u][/h1]

It wasn’t long until the Paths realized that the powerful Exosuits can offer more than mere protection to their Workers. Through new engineering and scientific solutions, they developed methods to improve their Exosuit models with Neutronium, Uranium, Titanium, and even scientific Breakthroughs. This way, even the more dangerous areas of the Outback became accessible, with their vast amount of salvageable materials, forgotten relics of the Old World - and, of course, new dangers to face.

notes.title: And our friends are all aboard
notes.content:
Set your sails and calibrate your compass in Feudum: Rudders & Ramparts! It's time to take artisan-edition vessels and castles out for a spin!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/816/1JLc53WdYqpsce9qeyF9V0.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum-rudders-and-ramparts]Feudum: Rudders & Ramparts[/url][/h1]
[u]2–6 Players; 80–180 Min[/u]

The Rudders & Ramparts expansion features artisan-edition vessels and castles that may be used purely for decoration - or to play a military variant of the game [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum]Feudum[/url]! Upon acquiring a regular vessel or feudum, players may pay an additional shilling to upgrade to a deluxe vessel or castle feudum. Players earn +1 attack for a deluxe vessel and +1 defense for a castle feudum. At the dawn of each epoch, players must pay 1 shilling to maintain each castle or deluxe vessel in their possession - or lose their advantage! 

 
[b]You still have a few days to support game on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/464687699/feudum-rudders-and-ramparts]Kickstarter[/url]![/b]

notes.title: 3 New Steam DLCs - Available Now!
notes.content:
Dear Tabletopians, today we announce another flight of highly requested games from our library - now available as Steam DLCs! You can now buy [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/noir]NOIR[/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/between-two-castles-of-mad-king-ludwig]Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig[/url] and [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-networks]The Networks[/url] to play them forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fe2811748b0f03baac6a81a17bd9d8ace8442981.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/noir]NOIR[/url][/h1]
NOIR is a game of hidden identities and deduction. Each player receives a secret identity from among 25 suspects and an open role that determines his available moves and victory conditions.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/649ac307e674b12c141c6093126f95d41f173ed8.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/between-two-castles-of-mad-king-ludwig]Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig[/url][/h1]
Between Two Castles of Mad King Ludwig is a competitive tile-drafting game in which each tile is a room in a castle. You work together with the player on your left to design one castle, and with the player on your right on another castle. On each turn you select two tiles from your hand, reveal them, then work with your partners to place them. To win, you have to share your attention and your devotion between two castles.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/6f8b6b340bbed2a90d7ba24afe1b3417aaf2b95f.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-networks]The Networks[/url][/h1]
Welcome to the TV business! You are the owner of a new television network. All you have are three awful public access shows, a small amount of cash, and endless ambition. Plus, it looks like you're not the only new TV network in town... Whose network will get the most Viewers and win the game?


You can purchase these new DLCs on our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]Steam product page[/url].

Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: 5 New Steam DLCs - Available Now!
notes.content:
Dear Tabletopians, today we announce another flight of highly requested games from our library - now available as Steam DLCs! You can now buy Euphoria, Sellswords, Millennium Blades, Maximum Apocalypse and Raiders of the North Sea to play them forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e484f37a89270cf34d06636b284b5b1468751317.png[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/euphoria-build-a-better-dystopia]Euphoria: Build a Better Dystopia[/url][/h1]
Euphoria is a worker-placement game in which dice are your workers. The number on each die represents his level of awareness that he's in a dystopia. Worker knowledge enables various bonuses and impacts player interaction. If the collective knowledge of all of your available workers gets too high, they might desert you. Your path to victory is paved with the sweat of your workers, the strength of your allegiances, and the tunnels you dig to infiltrate other areas of the world.

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sellswords-olympus]Sellswords[/url][/h1]
Sellswords is a tile-placement game (they're cards, not tiles, but you get the idea) for two players in which heroes gather for the battle of a lifetime. Each of the fifty heroes has its own ability to help turn the tiles of battle in your favor!

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/millennium-blades]Millennium Blades[/url][/h1]
In a world very much like our own, Millennium Blades is the world’s most popular collectible card game. Continuously in print for more than a thousand years, the game has seen countless expansions and untold billions of cards in circulation. Players from around the world and from all walks of life seek to become world champions by mastering duels and collecting the game’s rarest and most coveted cards. 

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/maximum-apocalypse]Maximum Apocalypse[/url][/h1]
Maximum Apocalypse is a cooperative game where each player plays as survivor with actions and gear in the form of cards. Players explore the landscape and react to threats from roaming monsters while trying to fend off starvation and scavenge for the resources needed to complete their mission and escape.

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/raiders-of-the-north-sea]Raiders of the North Sea[/url][/h1]
Raiders of the North Sea is set in the central years of the Viking Age. Players will need to assemble a crew, collect provisions and journey north to plunder gold, iron and livestock. There is glory to be found in battle, even at the hands of the Valkyrie. The aim is having the most Victory Points (VP) at the game’s end. Victory Points are gained primarily by raiding Settlements, taking Plunder and making Offerings to the Chieftain. The game ends when either 1 Fortress raid remains, all Valkyrie are removed, or all Offerings have been made.

You can purchase these new DLCs on our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]Steam product page[/url].

Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: 2 New Steam DLCs - Available Now!
notes.content:
Dear Tabletopians, we are happy to announce that two highly requested games from our library are now available as Steam DLCs! You can now buy [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/eight-minute-empire-legends]Eight-Minute Empire: Legends[/url] and [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/anachrony]Anachrony[/url] and play them forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ce213c2cfd5f9870b2315542edd29dcda3c5dc9d.png[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/eight-minute-empire-legends]Eight-Minute Empire: Legends[/url][/h1]
Eight-Minute Empire: Legends is a standalone sequel to the area control game Eight-Minute Empire and does not require the original game to play. Just like the original game, players take turns selecting a card from six on display. The card has an action that the player takes immediately, and actions help players take over the map, but instead of goods, cards now have special abilities, which give players unique advantages and ways to break the rules throughout the game. Build a small empire in a land of legends!

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/anachrony]Anachrony[/url][/h1]
Anachrony features an unique two-tiered worker placement system. To travel to the Capital or venture out to the devastated areas for resources, players need not only various Specialists, but also Exosuits to protect and enhance them - and both are in short supply. The game is played in 4-7 rounds, depending on the time when the looming cataclysm occurs. The elapsed turns are measured on a dynamic Timeline. By powering up the Time Rifts, players can reach back to earlier turns to supply their past "self" with resources. Each Path has a vastly different objective that rewards it with a massive amount of Victory Points when achieved. The Paths' settlements will survive the impact, but the Capital will not. Whichever Path manages to collect most points will be the new seat for the Capital, thus the most important force left on the planet.


You can purchase these new DLCs on our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]Steam product page[/url].

Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: 4 New Steam DLCs - Available Now!
notes.content:
Dear Tabletopians, we are happy to announce that four highly requested games from our library are now available as Steam DLCs! You can now buy [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/viticulture-essential-edition]Viticulture[/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tuscany-essential-edition]Tuscany[/url], [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum]Feudum[/url] and [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/argent-the-consortium]Argent: the Consortium[/url] and play them forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/38e38666eddbedaa02bd0360dcb396c536519734.png[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/viticulture-essential-edition]Viticulture[/url][/h1]
In Viticulture: Essential Edition, players find themselves in the roles of people in rustic Tuscany who have inherited meager vineyards. Every season is different, so the workers have different tasks they can take care of in the summer and winter. Fortunately for the players, people love to visit wineries, and many of those visitors are willing to help out when they visit. Using those workers and visitors, players can expand their vineyards by building structures, planting vines, and filling wine orders. Players work towards the goal of running the most successful winery in Tuscany.

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/tuscany-essential-edition]Tuscany[/url][/h1]
Tuscany is collection of expansions that reimagines original Viticulture in several new ways. It features new extended board, introduces new types of cards for structures and specialized workers. 
This collection is intended to take gameplay Viticulture to a whole new level, with additional area control mechanic and more opportunities for diversifying your strategies.

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum]Feudum + Expansions[/url][/h1]
Feudum is an economic medieval game of hand and resource management. With many strategies at their disposal, players optimize four actions per turn in attempt to score the most victory points. You will compete to acquire coveted feudums, which increase your membership status in one of six guilds. If you run your guilds wisely, maintain control of key locations and adapt best to changing events, you will be victorious. Long live the King!

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/argent-the-consortium]Argent: the Consortium[/url][/h1]
The time has come for the selection of a new Chancellor at Argent University of Magic, and you are among the likely candidates for the job. Argent: The Consortium is a cutthroat worker-placement/engine-building game of manipulation and secrecy in which the criteria for victory are secret and the capabilities of your opponents are constantly changing. You'll need to outwit the other candidates, use your spells at the right moment, and choose the correct apprentices to manage your plan.

You can purchase these new DLCs on our [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]Steam product page[/url].

Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Tabletopia Goes Mobile
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that we have launched the Beta version of Tabletopia on Tablets! 
[url=https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1274379679?pt=118594584&ct=steam_news&mt=8]Download Tabletopia for iPads now[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c6df1300fa276549da6cebfa03ac7ca3382eb3e1.png[/img]

Tabletopia Mobile now runs on iOS Tablets (Apple iPad Mini 2 or higher) and is accessible for free. Six games are already available and 500+ more from our extensive catalog are on the way:

[h1]1. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/champions-of-midgard]Champions of Midgard[/url][/h1]
A hit worker placement game about Viking clans waging war against mythological Norse beasts by Grey Fox Games
[h1]2. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-shipwreck-arcana]The Shipwreck Arcana[/url][/h1]
Very clever cooperative deduction game by Meromorph Games
[h1]3. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hansa-teutonica]Hansa Teutonica[/url][/h1]
One of the best competitive eurogames by Argentum Verlag
[h1]4. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/sub-terra]Sub Terra[/url][/h1] 
Cooperative survival horror board game by Inside the Box
[h1]5. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/burgle-bros]Burgle Bros[/url][/h1] 
Cooperative stealth game about daring robbery by Fowers Games
[h1]6. [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mint-works]Mint Works[/url][/h1] 
Light worker placement game of planning a city’s industry by Five24 Labs

Right now we’re porting games best for the Pass & Play mode already featured on Tabletopia Mobile. These include games with no hidden information and smaller setups due to screen size limitations compared to PC. Later the Online Multiplayer mode will be added, as well as support of Android tablets.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ad727032951d6c4ea208eb3d7e0883f70ada0342.png[/img]

With Tabletopia Mobile, publishers and game authors will be able to create mobile versions of their games in Workshop (Pro Subscription required) and playtest or demonstrate them on tablets. Stand alone apps featured in iOS and Android stores will also be supported with time. You can learn more about it [url=https://tabletopia.com/pages/mobile]here[/url].

Your feedback is very important to us! Feel free to contact us (at info@tabletopia.com ) with any comments after you give Tabletopia Mobile a try.

Yours,
Tabletopia Team

Light worker placement game of planning a city’s industry by Five24 Labs

These include games with no hidden information and smaller setups due to screen size limitations compared to PC. Later the Online Multiplayer mode will be added, as well as support of Android tablets.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/ad727032951d6c4ea208eb3d7e0883f70ada0342.png[/img]

With Tabletopia Mobile, publishers and game authors will be able to create mobile versions of their games in Workshop (Pro Subscription required) and playtest or demonstrate them on tablets. Stand alone apps featured in iOS and Android stores will also be supported with time. You can learn more about it [url=https://tabletopia.com/pages/mobile]here[/url].

Your feedback is very important to us! Feel free to contact us (at info@tabletopia.com ) with any comments after you give Tabletopia Mobile a try.

Yours,
Tabletopia Team

notes.title: Human Mind, and Nowhere Else...
notes.content:
Coordinate a group of dissidents or suppress dissent in [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/newspeak]NewSpeak[/url] - a new code-breaking team game of subterfuge, set in a bleak future for 3-6 citizens. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/fb1d24a933a5f1785001d00731cea5c0201ede39.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/news/newspeak]NewSpeak[/url][/h1]
3-6 Players; 45-60 Minutes

NewSpeak is a tense game of dystopian subversion in which you take the role of either the 'dissidents' or the 'moderators' in a mind-bending battle of wits to determine the reality around you. 

Dissidents utilise matching underground codes to coordinate meetings at one of the locations on the map. They then each secretly use their location dials to declare their intended meeting point.

The Mods, in a short amount of time, then have to determine where they expect the Dissidents to meet by inferring their intent from a book of every possible code set the subversives could use, and agree upon a location to direct a state raiding party.

Depending on whether the majority of Dissidents have successfully coordinated at a single location, or the Mods have caught them in an attempt at subversion will determine whether that location becomes 'hacked' or 'moderated'.

As the game progresses, moderated locations produce potential accomplices for the Dissidents to recruit, as undesirables are driven from now sanitized districts. However, as the Dissidents progress their mission to 'hack' as many locations as possible, the Moderators strike back with increasing numbers of surveillance outposts, installed to limit the Dissident's ability to move around the city undetected.

The game's [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/itbboardgames/newspeak-a-game-of-code-breaking-in-a-dystopian-fu]Kickstarter project[/url] is currently ongoing, so take this chance to fight for future reality.

notes.title: Clash in Skies of Europa
notes.content:
Dear Tabletopians, one of our most popular games Scythe now has new expansion [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/414238/Tabletopia__Scythe_The_Wind_Gambit/]The Wind Gambit[/url] available as a Steam DLC! You can now buy both expansions along with the base game and play forever, with no subscription required. As usual, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/7f9c8a011abe55876079dac50f43f4d75a3fcdf3.png[/img]

[h1][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/414238/Tabletopia__Scythe_The_Wind_Gambit/]Scythe: The Wind Gambit[/url][/h1]
This expansion to Scythe adds 2 new modules that can be played together or separately at any player count and with either the base game or other Scythe expansions. 

• [b]Airships[/b]: (1 miniature per faction; 16 tiles) An airship is a new type of unit that is distinctly different from characters, mechs, and workers. Unlike those units, airships never control territories. Airships are moved via a Move action, and rivers and lakes do not constrain their movement. Each airship has two randomly combined abilities (1 aggressive and 1 passive ability; same combo for all players).

• [b]Resolutions[/b]: (8 tiles) The resolution module changes the way a game of Scythe ends. If you play with this module, ignore the standard end-game trigger (when a player places their sixth star, everything stops and the game ends). Instead, the resolution tile for the current game will determine when and how the game ends.

[h1][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/414232/Tabletopia__Scythe_The_Wind_Gambit__Invaders_from_Afar/]Scythe: The Wind Gambit + Invaders from Afar[/url][/h1]
You also have an option to buy The Wind Gambit along with previous Scythe expansion Invaders from Afar in a single bundle. 

Scythe: Invaders from Afar adds two new factions: 10 miniatures, 62 custom wooden tokens, and 2 faction mats. While empires rise and fall in Eastern Europa, the rest of the world takes notice. Two distant factions, Albion and Togawa, send emissaries to scout the land and employ their own distinct styles of conquering.   

You can purchase the base game as well as expansions packages on [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]our Steam product page[/url].

Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs.

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: City of the Yellow King
notes.content:
Be first to summon Lost [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/carcosa]Carcosa[/url] and the King in Yellow in this new tile-laying, area-control game of secrets, schemes and sacrifice! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/75eb9bcdba08a967dabcc9cf779ad5798887b854.jpg[/img]

[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/carcosa]Carcosa[/url][/h1]
1-4 Players; 45-60 Minutes

In Carcosa, you will summon the city of the Tattered King, one tile at a time! Use your cultists to tap ley lines, conduct rituals and explore the districts of Carcosa itself. If your cultists displease you, you can sacrifice them to the dark waters of Lake Hali for the pleasure of the King. 

Only the most devious leader will be able to marshal his cult through The Coming of Carcosa and earn the right to wear the Pallid Mask!

notes.title: Expand Your Feudum!
notes.content:
Time to [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum-expansions]expand your Feudum[/url][/b] and bring new resources, actions, and monsters to the game!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/001/000/tXHfLvoPzbpBQaIMcZUgn6.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/feudum-expansions]Feudum: Expansions[/url][/b][/h1]
2–6 Players; 75–180 Min 

[i]Feudum[/i] is an economic medieval game of hand and resource management.

We introduce the expansions for this high-acclaimed game, including:
[list][*][b]Windmills and Catapults.[/b] This expansion lets you add new tiles and/or a 6th player to the game as well as introduces windmills and catapults, used during goods collection and attacks.
[*][b]Seals and Sirens.[/b] This expansion lets you add another food source and a monster to the game. 
[*][b]Alter Ego.[/b] This expansion lets you swap up to 6 of your action cards before the game begins with alternate cards featuring new special abilities. 
[*][b]Squirrels and Conifers.[/b] This expansion replaces the green food cubes with pink ones and creates a multiplying food source on the map.[/list]

[quote=Lance Myxter of Undead Viking ]"[i]Feudum[/i] is a rarity of rarities in the board game world. Feudum feels like it's a Pandora's box of that thing that I’m looking for: Tons of exploration and tons of ways to win. This is a game that I will be pulling down on a repeated basis. The game is absolutely fantastic."

notes.title: DLCs Come to Tabletopia! Scythe and Champions of Midgard with Expansions
notes.content:
Dear Tabletopians, we are very glad to announce that DLCs just became available on Tabletopia! With this new feature you can now buy games on Tabletopia to play forever, and no subscription is needed.

As the first batch, we’re happy to bring you [i]Scythe[/i] with [i]Invaders from Afar[/i] and [i]Champions of Midgard[/i] with [i]Valhalla[/i] and [i]The Dark Mountains[/i]. [i]Sub Terra[/i] with several new expansions is coming really soon, and we plan on adding more games later. Tell us in the comments which games you would like to see as DLCs!

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/999/RkymgPZkmyzm5Z5PwjZLUL.png[/img]

You can buy DLCs in two ways:
[list][*] [b]Directly in Tabletopia client[/b]. Launch the Tabletopia Steam application. On the eligible game’s page, click [b]Buy DLC[/b] to purchase the game (you will be redirected to Steam). 
[*][b]Through [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560/Tabletopia/]our page on Steam[/url].[/b] Add as many DLCs as you would like to your Cart.[/list]


[h1][b]Scythe + Invaders from Afar[/b][/h1]
[i][b]Scythe[/b] is an engine-building game set in an alternate-history 1920s period. Each player represents a character from one of the factions of Eastern Europe who are attempting to earn their fortune and claim their faction's stake in the land around the mysterious Factory. Players conquer territory, enlist new recruits, reap resources, gain villagers, build structures, and activate monstrous mechs.[/i]

[b]Please note that when buying an expansion, the base game is included in the price![/b]

[list][*][b]Limited offer:[/b] 15% launch discount!
[*]1–7 players, 16+, 90–120 min.
[*]As usually, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/414231/Tabletopia__Scythe/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/414232/Tabletopia__Scythe_Invaders_from_Afar/


[h1][b]Champions of Midgard + Valhalla + The Dark Mountains[/b][/h1]

[i][b]Champions of Midgard[/b] is a middleweight, Viking-themed, worker placement game with dice rolling in which players are leaders of Viking clans who have traveled to an embattled Viking harbor town to help defend it against the threat of trolls, draugr, and other mythological Norse beasts. By defeating these epic creatures, players gain glory and the favor of the gods.[/i]

[b]Please note that when buying an expansion, the base game is included in the price![/b]

[list][*][b]Limited offer:[/b] 15% launch discount!
[*]2–5 players, 10+, 60–120 min.
[*]As usually, only the host needs to own the DLC, your guests play for free.[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/414230/Tabletopia__Champions_of_Midgard/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/414234/Tabletopia__Champions_of_Midgard_Valhalla/

http://store.steampowered.com/app/414233/Tabletopia__Champions_of_Midgard_The_Dark_Mountains/

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: The Sky Just Got Bigger
notes.content:
Skyward, the world’s first airborne city, is back and it's bigger than ever! Two expansions were just added to make for the ultimate [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/skyward-expansions]Skyward[/url][/b] experience. Check it out.

[img]https://tabletopia.gcdn.co/static/files/000/960/tlyAvYWR23LyGoy2IyX1tz1.jpg[/img]

[h1] [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/skyward-expansions]Skyward: Expansions[/url][/b][/h1] 
2–4 Players; 30–45 Min

[i]Skyward[/i] is a strategy card drafting game of control versus opportunity for 2-4 players. The following expansions are included:
[list][*][b]Allegiance Expansion:[/b] with this expansion you’ll be able to earn prestige by building new societies, not just new cities. At the end of the game add the VP from your completed Allegiances to your final score.
[*][b]Discord Expansion[/b] gives you the opportunity to find peacetime applications for treasures from the war. At the end of the game, the player with the most Discord cards loses 4 Victory Points.[/list]
[quote= Gameapalooza]"[i]Skyward: The Airborne City[/i] is a really nice game. [...] if you are looking for an easy to teach / play city builder that's portable and gorgeous, I'd highly recommend [i]Skyward[/i].[...] Game designer Brendan Evans came up with an efficient 'I split/you choose' game mechanic."

notes.title: 7 Faction Army: The Invaders are Here
notes.content:
What can be more endearing to a tabletop player than to get an expansion for a great game? [i]Scythe[/i] fans, this is for you: now that [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/scythe-invaders-from-afar]Invaders from Afar[/url][/b] is added to our catalog, you can play [i]Scythe[/i] on Tabletopia with all 7 factions for the ultimate experience!

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/951/Ofyr318ozS19NyIlxONOrD.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/scythe-invaders-from-afar]Invaders from Afar[/url][/b][/h1]
1–7 Players; 90–120 Min

[i]Scythe: Invaders from Afar[/i] is an expansion for [i]Scythe[/i]. It adds two new factions—Albion and Togawa—and two new player mats, making it possible to play with 7 players.

[quote=The Cardboard Herald]"While Invaders From Afar doesn’t fundamentally change Scythe, it really rounds out the variety in the game; keeping it fresh, alive, and interesting. I think Albion and Togawa are the most interesting of the now 7 factions."

notes.title: Master of the Galaxy: Per Tabletopia Ad Astra
notes.content:
[b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/master-of-galaxy]Master of the Galaxy[/url][/b] is a fast-pacing, innovative 4X board game with bag-building & card drafting in which you jump to the stars and build your galactic civilization. After two years of development the game [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1402889231/354143093?token=11d57f1f]hits Kickstarter on July 18[/url] to be released by [url=http://www.aresgames.eu/]Ares Games[/url] and [url=http://igrology.ru/eng/]Igrology[/url]

Don’t miss the special [i]Master of the Galaxy[/i] giveaway on Gleam for a chance to win one of three available Kickstarter exclusive copies! The more points you collect, the higher your chance to win. Find the link [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/master-of-galaxy-kickstarter]on our website[/url]

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/943/n8ZxDGxemugTLfZxJiseE3.png[/img]

[i]Master of the Galaxy[/i] was initially created and developed on Tabletopia, which was also used for extensive digital playtesting. [b]4000 people played it online during 3400 hours[/b], something that is impossible to achieve with physical prototypes! The game was also often requested by players for our Learn & Play sessions.

Thanks to numerous testing sessions and feedback the authors made many important changes to the gameplay, including:
[list][*]Totally remade government cards and added unique abilities
[*]Improved conflict and leader cards
[*]Added more player interaction
[*]Substantially revamped development cards
[*]Added a new path to victory for those who want to develop science not expansion, etc.[/list]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/943/ghy3zm6MGRvmytHStsP5H7.jpg[/img]

The game was also presented to many publishers on conventions and fairs. Igrology Studio decided to release the game together with Ares Games, publishers of [i]War of the Ring[/i], [i]Sword and Sorcery[/i], [i]Wings of Glory[/i], and many other popular titles.

[b]Stay in touch: [/b]
[list][*]Join the [url=https://www.facebook.com/masterofthegalaxy]game’s Facebook group[/url] to stay up-to-date with all the hottest news.
[*][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/master-of-galaxy]Play the game today for free on Tabletopia[/url] while you wait for the campaign to start on July 18.[/list]

[img]https://tabletopia.com/static/files/000/943/rcZ424eIqtrkX2uqCzEyPD.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Games of the Rising Sun
notes.content:
Great news for those who like classic two-player Japanese games! Meet two additions to our catalog: [i]Hanafuda[/i] and [i]Shogi[/i].

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/moon-rabbit-hanafuda]Moon Rabbit Hanafuda[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 60 Min

[i]Hanafuda[/i] (literally 'Flower card') is a deck of beautiful cards originated in 18th-century Japan.

The deck consists of 48 cards divided into 12 suits of four cards each. Each suit represents one of the twelve months of the year or individual plants.

[i]Koi-Koi[/i] is a popular Japanese game. Match cards from your hand and the deck to cards in the field to create Yaku or point combinations. 

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/903/2c0BYclidQ1YzPvt08fc62.jpg?maxwidth=3200&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/japanese-chess=]Shogi & Chu Shogi[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 105–120 Min 

[i]Shogi[/i] is known as the Japanese chess and is played on a 9×9 board, and the object is to capture the opponent's king. The two main differences with Western chess are:
[list][*]not only pawns but almost any piece can promote if it reaches the opponents three last rows
[*]captured pieces become property of the capturing player and can be "droped" back on the board.[/list]
[i]Chu Shogi[/i] is played on a 12×12 board and each player controls 46 pieces. The object is to capture your opponent's King (and Crown Prince, if they have promoted their Drunk Elephant). Unlike [i]Shogi[/i], this game is played without drops.  

[img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/924/Ckx2W0ZnEqX03LVau4mUb1.jpg?maxwidth=1800&maxheight=1800&format=jpg&quality=80[/img]

notes.title: New Games Digest: The Hackers Guild, Hat-Trick + Players, Norsaga: Odds and Endings, Metal Dawn, Campo Bello, Werewolf Vs Vampire
notes.content:
Hey Tabletopians,

In today's new games digest we introduce six new titles recently added to our catalog: [i]The Hackers Guild, Hat-Trick + Players, Norsaga: Odds and Endings, Metal Dawn, Campo Bello, Werewolf Vs Vampire[/i]. Note that some of these games are now on Kickstarter where you can support them after first trying on Tabletopia.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/4db3944e57048cd548b05523b629cde03d2cc59c.png[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-hackers-guild]The Hackers Guild[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 90 Min

[i]The Hackers Guild[/i] is a cooperative game where you will take on the role of members of The Hackers Guild, and will try to work together to find login creentials and malware to complete the final hack against Monolith Global's data center.

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/924/53s6RGb73bKe3zdFZQL4J1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/hat-trick-base-game-players-expansion]Hat-Trick + Players[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Hat-Trick[/i] is a highly-tactical football card game for two players (managers) that simulates a complete football (soccer) match. 

Managers use player-cards to make a football pitch and move their players, while two identical sets of action cards let them perform various actions: short passes, long balls or dribblings. 

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/924/hdlIqS7fMPK5JpT9vcw6I3.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/norsaga]Norsaga: Odds and Endings[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 30 Min

[i]Norsaga[/i] is a 2-4 player puzzle battle card game in which players take the role of Viking poets who are vying to describe their personal saga and their heroic ancestry, while embellishing their story with tricks they've inherited.

[i]Odds and Endings[/i] is an expansion, introducing immortal heroes, cursed relics, strange realms, and more lying about your ancestors. [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/meromorphgames/norsaga-odds-and-endings-expansion]Now on Kickstarter![/url][/b] To play, select respective setup.

[img]https://tabletopia.com/static/files/000/813/uHb1CAZKrLpykg6NBSk6k1.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/metal-dawn]Metal Dawn[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 60–90 Min

[i]Metal Dawn[/i] is ais a new sci-fi action-adventure cooperative game. The players are a united faction of agents whose mission is to destroy the forces of the machine while hacking the network to take down the satellite before it’s too late.

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/everythingepicgames/metal-dawn]This game's on Kickstarter now![/url][/b]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/924/5Y70K20ZHSpQ4AzH6x5jn6.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/campobello]Campo Bello[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 10–20 Min

[i]Campo Bello[/i] is a fun, abstract family game for 2-4 players that adds a multiplayer twist to the traditional peg solitaire game. To win Campo Bello, remove your pieces from the board first.

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/924/beT5fxIi3RVTIC3nTjLFZ3.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/campobello]Werewolf vs. Vampire[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 15–25 Min

[i]Werewolf vs. Vampire[/i] is a tactical game that brings these creatures to life through their unique abilities. Plan ahead by building paths through this unknown world. But watch out, your opponent is trying to block you just as much as you are trying to block them! Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dinkheller/werewolf-vs-vampire]This game's on Kickstarter now![/url][/b]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/924/YoRPzLvkDchhVM7Bv4RR14.jpg[/img]

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Travel to the Heart of the Mists
notes.content:
The time has come to brave the mists again, now with the standalone expansion [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mistfall-heart-of-the-mists]Mistfall: Heart of the Mists[/url][/b] in which the legendary adventure from [i]Mistfall[/i] by NSKN Games continues. 

Join mighty heroes, face ruthless enemies and dire threats, and brave the path that will lead you into the Heart of the Mists!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0b44bebc895d4e4ad679f701c6d9d202ef7ab005.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mistfall-heart-of-the-mists]Mistfall: Heart of the Mists[/url][/b][/h1]
1–4 Players; 30–120 Min

[i]Heart of the Mists[/i] is a fully cooperative card-based adventure game set in a dark fantasy world of wonder and peril. It can be played standalone or fully combined and integrated with [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/mistfall]Mistfall[/url]

In this adventure you will find new Heroes, Enemies, Encounters, and Quests, as well as alternative versions of some of the base game mechanisms. Gather up your resolve, check your gear and get ready to go to brave the heart of the perilous Mists!

[quote=Jonathan Rowe]"[i]Heart of the Mists[/i] in every way takes what was good about Mistfall and either keeps it good or makes it great. The prospect of introducing the new Heroes to the old ones in “guest starring…” roles is very exciting for old-timers but this is an ideal jumping-on point for newcomers to the game and its world."

notes.title: Play Later Mode Added to Tabletopia
notes.content:
Hey Tabletopians, 

We’re glad to announce Play Later, a brand new feature in our Playground that lets you schedule games for future!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/4c6c83955449156d6a709b79ec02733d95889064.png[/img]

It’s not always possible to play here and now. With Play Later you can plan the time and game you want to play up to 14 days ahead and let other people join if the time’s convenient for them. 

Also, you can add the event to your calendar so that you don’t miss it. Tabletopia will remind you about the game 15 minutes prior through your browser (you need to allow push-up notifications from Tabletopia in your browser to use this feature). 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bd9a6840b6175abc68fc719eef04d54e23862434.png[/img]

Our Learn & Play events are now also featured on this page so that you always know what’s being learned and played this week. 

Let us know what you think of this new feature in [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/4PsHHKm]Discord[/url]!

[h1][b]How To Start With Play Later[/b][/h1]
[b]To see all scheduled games,[/b] go to Playground > Find & Play > Play Later. All games are displayed in your local time for maximum convenience. 

[b]To join a game,[/b] click the room > Join. And don’t forget to open Tabletopia when the game is due :)

[b]To schedule a game:[/b]
[list][*]Create a game room as usual.
[*]Check “Schedule for later” in the Room Options section.
[*]Choose the date and time and enter an optional welcome message. Your scheduled game is ready! [/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/4e53e7ef4802ce4f942b21f9b58dd1b563331540.png[/img]

The game will be displayed in the Play Later section for other players to join. At the time of the game, you will need to launch it once the players are assembled. For more details on Play Later see [url=http://help.tabletopia.com/knowledge-base/play-later/]our article in Help[/url]

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: More Aliens, More Frontiers
notes.content:
Good news, everyone! [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/alien-frontiers-factions]Alien Frontiers: Factions[/url][/b] was added to our catalog, which means that you can now play one of our hits [i]Alien Frontiers[/i] with various cool alien factions and use their unique powers!

Also, read [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/tory-niemann-dont-underestimate-the-glossy-vibrant-dice/]our interview with the game's author Tory Niemann[/url] if you haven't read it before.

 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0bef0f491eb8bd4ff80b31d68d8439a4b33cae26.jpg[/img]


[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/alien-frontiers-factions]Alien Frontiers: Factions[/url][/b] [/h1]
2–5 Players; 60–90 Min

[i]Alien Frontiers: Factions[/i] is an expansion for [i]Alien Frontiers[/i] and adds a number of items to the base game:
[list][*]Factions, each providing a special ability and new orbital facilities.
[*]Agendas, which are hidden objectives that allow a player to earn bonus points at game's end or when the agenda is revealed in-game.
[*]New Alien Tech cards.[/list]
[quote=Tory Niemann, game's author]"My favorite Faction is the Scavenger Fleet. Being able to get dice all the time and being able to use them immediately is a big edge. I’m also fond of the Uranian Syndicate in a four or five player game, since there is bound to be lots of conflict. "

notes.title: The Revolution is Here
notes.content:
Get ready for the industrial revolution! [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/brass-birmingham]Brass: Birmingham[/url][/b], a finely brewed sequel to the famous economic strategy boardgame [i]Brass[/i] by Martin Wallace, is now on Tabletopia.
 
The game is [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/roxley/brass-an-industrial-revolution]now at full steam on Kickstarter[/url] and you can still jump on the bandwagon and back it if you hurry!

 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a099429e472e50ec569059dab2b1e4856e5c0bee.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/brass-birmingham]Brass: Birmingham[/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 150–180 Min

[i]Brass: Birmingham[/i] is an economic strategy game and a sequel to Martin Wallace' 2007 masterpiece, [i]Brass[/i].

As competing entrepreneurs in Birmingham during the industrial revolution in 1770-1870, you will develop, build, and establish your industries and network, in an effort to exploit low or high market demands.

The game offers a very different story arc and experience from its predecessor with multiple interesting new strategies waiting for you to discover. Also new in this game:
[list][*]Dynamic board setup
[*]New canal/rail scoring
[*]3 new industry types, etc.[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/f30f74cc83858935dbd74b7cf9f729a1ce395f3d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Break the Magic Seals
notes.content:
It's time to explore the dungeon of the Arcana Tower in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/five-seals-of-magic]Five Seals of Magic[/url][/b] and find some powerful spells! Use the dice of four matching colors to break the seals and clear a path to the scrolls.

Take a look at the new revised edition of the game [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maydaygames/five-seals-of-magic-board-game-2-5-player-60-minut/]now on Kickstarter[/url] (funded) complete with:  
[list][*]updated rules, including a new use for your familiar spell
[*]revised game board
[*]three new spell circles available as add-ons[/list]
 
Also, a free live Learn & Play session of [i]Five Seals of Magic[/i] is scheduled for the next week, stay tuned for further announcement!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/744d3700bc45dd0a71ad43035092ac226e558b12.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/five-seals-of-magic]Five Seals of Magic[/url][/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 30–60 Min

[i]Five Seals of Magic[/i] is an adventure dice rolling set collection game.

As mages seeking more power, you will try to break seals and open way to magic scrolls on the map of a dungeon. Keep an eye on your opponents and be sure to use your powers at the right time and at the right place. The player who collects the most powerful scrolls wins!

[quote=Dan King, Game Boy Geek]"The artwork is awesome. I love when casting your spells, you can catapult them together to get a bunch of cool effects."

notes.title: Catch Me If You Can
notes.content:
Will you be the Chaser or the Chased? [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fugitive]Fugitive[/url][/b] is a new game by Tim Fowers ([i]Paperback[/i], [i]Burgle Bros[/i] are also on Tabletopia) where one player is a fugitive trying to make it out of town while being pursued by an unstoppable marshal. Fun, easy, and just 10 minutes to play!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/c15d9b8b55f668b0c44a14a3b4db3ce2da9a6f78.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/fugitive]Fugitive[/url][/b][/h1]
2 Players; 5–20 Min

[i]Fugitive[/i] is a tense two-player deduction card game set in the world of Burgle Bros.

The fugitive plays cards face down to the table trying to work their way to a goal, while the agent must guess those cards to uncover them. If all the cards are face up, the fugitive is caught. Bluff, guess,  and win!

[quote= Geek Dad]"I think [i]Fugitive[/i] is an excellent game for two. It plays fairly quickly and I love the cat-and-mouse mind games that go on."

notes.title: Riichi Mahjong Is Now on Tabletopia
notes.content:
Good news for those who love classic games — [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/riichi-mahjong]Riichi Mahjong[/url][/b] was added to our free catalog! If you like advanced card games, such as [i]Bridge[/i], [i]Preferans[/i], and some heavier variants of [i]Poker[/i], take a look at this time-honoured classic.

Also, we recommend checking out other [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/stay-classy-20-classic-board-games-on-tabletopia/]20+ card, dice, domino and other classic games[/url] we have for you for free.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/5ae7e45873f1b2badc89130b4e32fec337654e69.jpg[/img]
 
[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/riichi-mahjong]Riichi Mahjong[/url][/b][/h1]
4 Players; 90–180 Min

[i]Riichi Mahjong[/i] is a very specific remake from Japan of the traditional Chinese Mahjong with several differences, such as rīchi and the use of dora.

Today, the worldwide famous Mahjong Association officially recognized the complete rules of Riichi Mahjong for Tournaments.

notes.title: Introducing Hotseat Mode on Tabletopia
notes.content:
Today we introduce a new way to play games on Tabletopia: Hotseat mode. 

Now you can play any game in our catalog with your friends or family on the same desktop, including games with hidden information, like a hand of cards!
[list][*][b]To play a game on one PC,[/b] click [b]Play Hotseat[/b] on the game’s page and choose a setup for your number of players, if available. The game will start loading immediately.

[*]While in game, click [b]End Turn[/b] to pass the turn to the next player. Note that your hand will now be hidden and your opponent will not see it.[/list]

notes.title: Introducing Hotseat Mode on Tabletopia
notes.content:
Today we introduce a new way to play games on Tabletopia: Hotseat mode. 

Now you can play any game in our catalog with your friends or family on the same desktop, including games with hidden information, like a hand of cards!
[list][*][b]To play a game on one PC,[/b] click [b]Play Hotseat[/b] on the game’s page and choose a setup for your number of players, if available. The game will start loading immediately.

[*]While in game, click [b]End Turn[/b] to pass the turn to the next player. Note that your hand will now be hidden and your opponent will not see it.[/list]

Test the new mode now in [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/santorini]Santorini[/url] and check other [url=https://tabletopia.com/games?category=hot-seat]games perfect to play in Hotseat[/url] in our new category.

notes.title: Defend the King's Armory
notes.content:
A new game on Tabletopia: [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-king-s-armory]The King's Armory[/url][/b] a fully cooperative, strategic tower defense board game designed after your favorite online TD games!

We also recommend checking out the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/johnwrot/halfsies-dice-the-world-tour] Halfsies Dice campaign[/url] by [i]The King's Armory[/i] author John Wrot!, now in its final hours on Kickstarter. Get cool two-tone polyhedral dice sets for this or any other game in your collection.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/08079d60b8288bf66299e7bcbdea205ffa6cbbaa.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/the-king-s-armory]The King's Armory[/url][/b][/h1]
1–7 Players; 30–240 Min

[i]The King's Armory[/i] is a co-op tower defense game for 1-7 players.

Choose one of seven playable Heroes and their Hireables to lead the King’s defenses and destroy waves of monsters try to break into the King's Armory. Kill 'em all to win!

[quote=Father Geek]"[i]The King’s Armory[/i] is a really big game that does a really great job of capturing the complexity of [tower defence]. The game is very playable, and more to point, enjoyable."

notes.title: Tabletopia Update: March 17
notes.content:
In this recent update we introduce a special [b]Solo mode[/b] that let's you start solitaire games faster and easier.

For games that support one-player mode, you can now select solo or multiplayer mode directly on the game's page. If you click [b]Play Solo[/b], the appropriate setup will start launching immediately. 

Chat, turn-based modes, and lobby are disabled for this mode.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/b7a6b7913333ec0093fec400b2a410490c26be95.png[/img]

[h1][b]Other Features[/b][/h1]
Optimized execution time for most frequent actions, such as Join/Leave Seat, Start/Pause Game, etc. 

[h1][b]Bugs Fixed[/b][/h1]
[list][*]IE/Edge: header caching errors.
[*]IE: stars were not displayed on bookmarked games.
[*]Mac-Steam All Games: category drop-down was not correctly displayed. 
[*]Tokens with enabled Complex Collider could not be put into bags. [/list]

notes.title: Your Personal Game Coach on Tabletopia
notes.content:
Playing board games is fun, discovering new games is even more fun, reading the rules for each game...not so fun for many people. Especially if it’s a complex game with a lot of rules, like Scythe or Terra Mystica.

That’s why we at Tabletopia would like to introduce our new service — your personal board game coach! With this service it is you who chooses the game, time and people to play with, and we teach you.

 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0d327b01389824f6897b0199b86e394f36309075.png[/img]

[h1][b]How this works:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Choose any board game from [url=https://tabletopia.com/games]our catalog of over 360+ titles[/url].
[*]Choose the day and time when you can play.
[*]Contact us a couple of days before the chosen date to book the lesson and receive confirmation.
[*]Pay $15/hour in advance via PayPal.
[*]Invite any number of friends (they play for free or you can split the cost).
[*]One of our coaches, Vlad or Anton, will meet you online at the chosen time, teach you the rules and play the first introductory game with you. [/list]

To take part, you will need a mic and speakers. Also, we strongly recommend joining [url=https://discord.gg/4PsHHKm]our Discord server[/url] for in-game voice communication.
 

Interested? Send a message to info@tabletopia.com now to book your first gaming lesson! Or arrange an individual learn & play session for a friend as a very special present! ;)


Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: In Space They Can Hear You Run
notes.content:
You're deep in space and are suddenly under attack by aliens... Grab your escape pod or suit and run for your life! And beware alien Warriors, Spawns, and Queens patrolling the space around the station.

So, who will be able to escape to safety in [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/survive-space-attack]Survive: Space Attack![/url][/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1afc70847bcedc528560a57a7eac21dd5b3fc108.jpg[/img]

[h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/survive-space-attack]Survive: Space Attack![/url][/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 45–60 Min

[i]Survive: Space Attack![/i] is a reimplementation of a beloved classic [url=https://tabletopia.com/news/survive-escape]Survive: Escape From Atlantis![/url] also on Tabletopia, but with some additional mechanics and features from the authors of [url=https://tabletopia.com/games/space-cadets-dice-duel]Space Cadets: Dice Duel[/url]

You'll find here: new fighter ships to capture and redeploy aliens, laser turrets that can defend the station, new alien and tile abilities, and more!

 [quote=Mark Jackson of Opinionated Gamers]"[i]Survive: Space Attack![/i] takes pretty everything that works from the classic Survive game system, strips out the parts that don’t, adds more decisions, and keeps it ripping right along at a family-friendly pace. My boys asked for this every night for a week when we first got it!"[/quote]

notes.title: Tabletopia Update: February 9
notes.content:
Hey Tabletopians,

Here’s a list of features and fixes from our latest release.

[h1][b]Features[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Game page: Improved access to rules, added list of setups.
[*]Country and city selection in player profile made easier, and other minor improvements.
[*]Lobby: You will now be asked to confirm that you want to leave the lobby if you already took a seat.
[*]Game: Added Korea and India regions to game servers to reduce ping, improve response and stability for players from these regions.
[*]Game: You can now use magnetic map for decks.[/list]

[h1][b]Fixed:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Player profile: City selection for certain countries.
[*]Game: While moving or rotating an object other objects on top of it did not keep their position.
[*]Find & Play: Players directly took seats in the lobby by clicking “Open Lobby” in the Details pop-up.
[*]Find & Play: Players could not create new rooms due to erroneous room limits.
[*]Find & Play: Players received notification "Room not found" after clicking the room ID in the general chat.[/list]

Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.content:

[*]Second, we're proud to let you know that Tabletopia now features the all-new version of [i]Alient Frontiers[/i] with the revamped graphics.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/8be7f63de5beadf157f22f0cc62a022f2cb03c73.jpg[/img]

[*]Fourth, we’re also very happy to have talked with Tory Niemann, the designer of the game, who told us a lot of interesting stuff about the game and is just a super nice guy to talk to :) Read the [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/tory-niemann-dont-underestimate-the-glossy-vibrant-dice/]exclusive interview on our blog[/url][/list]

notes.title: Your Zoo Just Got Expanded: 3 Expansions for Zooloretto Released
notes.content:
Good news for all the zoo and animal lovers: three new expansions for [b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/zooloretto]Zooloretto[/url][/b] were just added to our catalog.

[i]Zooloretto[/i] is a family style game about managing your zoo and populating it with various animals. The game received numerous awards including the prestigious Spiel des Jahres.

And now you can add more variety to this game on Tabletopia by including not one but three different expansions!

[list][*][h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/zooloretto-the-savings-book-expansion]Zooloretto The Savings Book Expansion[/url][/b][/h1]
With this little addtition a player can get additional money during the game.

[*][h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/zooloretto-xxl-expansion]Zooloretto XXL Expansion[/url][/b][/h1]
Share animals by sending them to other zoos to get reward. Includes two extra trucks.

[*][h1][b][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/zooloretto-exotic-expansion]Zooloretto Exotic Expansion[/url][/b][/h1]
Build a new jungle experience path with strange exotic animals. The stands pay double because of the increased business.
[/list]
Happy gaming, and see you at the table!

notes.title: Master of the Galaxy: New Features, Live Demo
notes.content:
[url=https://tabletopia.com/games/master-of-galaxy][b]Master of the Galaxy[/b][/url], one of the most popular games on Tabletopia, gets a massive update! New features include:
[list][*]Improved conflict and leader cards
[*]Substantially revamped development cards 
[*]Totally remade government cards
[*]A new victory condition added
[*]Factions balance improved[/list]
Also, don't miss a [b]free live demonstration[/b] scheduled for Sunday January, 8 at 11 AM (EST). [url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/cw6GQh]Sign up now![/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/e89c94634443a88b44d235f2412c7883c8960f00.jpg[/img]
[h1][url=https://tabletopia.com/games/master-of-galaxy]
[b]Master of the Galaxy[/b][/url][/h1]
2–4 Players; 60 Min; [b]on Tabletopia only[/b]

[i]Master of the Galaxy[/i] is fast and furious 4Х board game inspired by the best-selling computer game Master of Orion. eXplore, eXpand, eXploit, eXterminate! 

At the start of your conquest of the Galaxy you have one star system, one Race card and modest supply of resources. During the game you fill your bag with new resources that may lead you to victory depending on the chosen strategy.

notes.title: Beginner's Guide and Other News
notes.content:
Hey Tabletopians,

So many of you joined us since our recent realease on Steam. It's great!

At the same time we understand that for new players and beginners the system might seem a bit overwhelming. That's why we've prepared a [url=http://help.tabletopia.com/knowledge-base/beginners-guide/]Beginner's Guide[/url] for you to get you started on Tabletopia in 4 simple steps. Check it out now!

[url=http://help.tabletopia.com/knowledge-base/beginners-guide/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bd4b5188b7bd9fc7fa794b28c1944133d6e63000.png[/img][/url]

***
Next, we would like to let you know that we constatly gather and analyze your feedback about connection issues, glitches, freezes, and slow response. We're working really hard to fix these bugs. In our recent technical release the following fixes were made:
[list][*]Main page performance and loading speed boosted (expected to decrease from 18 sec to 5-7 sec)
[*]Caching for most frequently-used data enabled
[*]Server capacities increased
[*]Link to access the game's page added to the game lobby[/list]
More things are planned and already in development. Your feedback helps a lot, and the more detailed (including logs, computer characteristics, etc.), the better.

***
Also, for those of you who make your games on Tabletopia, please be sure to [b]add only games that were created and designed by you[/b]. Our moderators will be forced to delete all games that are added without the permission of their right-holders.

Let's keep Tabletopia 100% licensed and a place where each can create, playtest, and demonstrate their own games. Thank you for your understanding.

tags.bug: - Main page performance and loading speed boosted (expected to decrease from 18 sec to 5-7 sec)

tags.feature: - Link to access the game's page added to the game lobby

notes.title: Early Access for Tabletopia is Over
notes.content:
We are glad to announce that our Early Access stage on Steam is now over. We would like to thank you all for supporting us during this period. Thanks for the bugs you've found, for the feedback you've provided, for the games you've played and created, and for simply being there with us from the start.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bd820c064b36613e22647cae6dccdfd6b8529664.png[/img]

Since the beginning of Early Access in March, we’ve worked hard to add over [b]80 games[/b] and a bunch of new features, to name a few:
[list][*]New user friendly lobby 
[*]Smart matchmaking game suggestions 
[*]Ready-check feature
[*]Real-time notifications
[*]Game results mode
[*]Improved user profile and many other small tweaks, improvements, and bug fixes.[/list]

We still have a long to-do list and a lot of plans, and we will continue adding new games and new features for you around the clock.

Note that the Early Access stage for the browser version still continues. But we plan on making the basic access free-of-charge on all platforms by the end of this month when Tabletopia is commercially released. Stay tuned, and happy gaming!

notes.title: Warmonger: Deck-Building War Game (only on Tabletopia)
notes.content:
We're really proud to announce [b][url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/warmonger]Warmonger[/url][/b] a deck-building direct interaction game that is available to play on Tabletopia only. 

[quote=Dan May, the designer of Warmonger]When I first discovered Tabletopia and saw what could be accomplished on your platform, it was actually the reason I decided to commission art and finally complete the game, which I have had in developmental stages for years. I added sound effects and even licensed music to use in the musicbox. It's a finished product, and Tabletopia is the only place to play it. [/quote]

The author has also promised to make a live demo of this game in the upcoming weeks, so stay tuned!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/810a61565a58f97d0352f8a75a986e6e7ea6ed6f.png[/img]

[h1][b]Warmonger[/b][/h1]
2–4 Players; 90–150 Min; [url=https://www.boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/212968/warmonger]Game on BGG[/url]
 
[i]Warmonger[/i] is a simple yet strategic board game for 2-4 players, combining the structure of a deck building game with the direct player interaction of a war game.

As the crown's greatest Warlord, you must prove your worth by defeating the lesser Warlords contesting for the throne. You'll need to win the loyalty of many followers, build mighty fortifications, and devise cunning tactics to become the new ruler of the kingdom... May the best Warlord win!

notes.title: Tabletopia is Now Free-to-Play on Steam
notes.content:
Starting Nov 22, 9PM EST, [b]Tabletopia becomes free-to-play on Steam*[/b]. From now on you can join Tabletopia on Steam for free, as well as play most of the 300 games featured on the platform. 

If you purchased Tabletopia during the Early Access stage, [b]you now have 30 days of Premium for free as a thank you for supporting us.[/b] After these 30 days expire, you will be switched to the free plan. If you don’t yet have Premium, consider purchasing it to unlock the full Tabletopia potential and give your support to favourite authors and publishers.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a439829e4ce97474ee15efd207f4e610d89e7be5.png[/img]

Moreover, today we also introduce the [b]in-app purchases[/b] that will be directly available in the Tabletopia Steam client. These purchases have replaced the subscriptions for Steam users in order to make Tabletopia more accessible to all players.

In-app purchases are basically [b]short-term Premiums[/b] that you buy once to receive full Premium access for a specified period of time: [b]3, 7, 14, or 30 days[/b].

[b]With any Premium purchase you get:[/b]
[list][*]unlimited access to all our games, expansions, and setups
[*]ability to invite your friends outside Tabletopia or fellow players to any games for free, including premium games
[*]up to 10 open games simultaneously[/list]

In-apps give you more flexibility without any long-time commitment or recurring payments. [i]You[/i] decide when you need your Premium and for how long.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1804f8630569611d8474d7a27dba5b899d744a37.png[/img]

*Note that the [b]Early Access stage for the browser version still continues[/b]. You cannot create a free account in the browser. However, you can now create a free account in Steam and then access the browser version with your Steam credentials for free (for details see [url=http://help.tabletopia.com/knowledge-base/steam-account-activation/#Getting_Access_to_Browser_Versionfor_Steam_Users]Activating Steam Account[/url]). 

In a few weeks we plan to make the browser version free-to-play as well with subscritpion-based Premium access.

Fore more details and answers about in-apps and free Tabletopia, see our [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/free-tabletopia-on-steam-in-apps]special article on blog[/url].

http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560

notes.content:
Starting Nov 22, 9PM EST, [b]Tabletopia becomes free-to-play on Steam*[/b]. From now on you can join Tabletopia on Steam for free, as well as play most of the 300 games featured on the platform. 

If you purchased Tabletopia during the Early Access stage, [b]you now have 30 days of Premium for free as a thank you for supporting us.[/b] After these 30 days expire, you will be switched to the free plan. If you don’t yet have Premium, consider purchasing it to unlock the full Tabletopia potential and give your support to favourite authors and publishers.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a439829e4ce97474ee15efd207f4e610d89e7be5.png[/img]

Moreover, today we also introduce the [b]in-app purchases[/b] that will be directly available in the Tabletopia Steam client. These purchases have replaced the subscriptions for Steam users in order to make Tabletopia more accessible to all players.

In-app purchases are basically [b]short-term Premiums[/b] that you buy once to receive full Premium access for a specified period of time: [b]3, 7, 14, or 30 days[/b].

[b]With any Premium purchase you get:[/b]
[list][*]unlimited access to all our games, expansions, and setups
[*]ability to invite your friends outside Tabletopia or fellow players to any games for free, including premium games
[*]up to 10 open games simultaneously[/list]

In-apps give you more flexibility without any long-time commitment or recurring payments. [i]You[/i] decide when you need your Premium and for how long.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1804f8630569611d8474d7a27dba5b899d744a37.png[/img]

*Note that the [b]Early Access stage for the browser version still continues[/b]. You cannot create a free account in the browser. However, you can now create a free account in Steam and then access the browser version with your Steam credentials for free (for details see [url=http://help.tabletopia.com/knowledge-base/steam-account-activation/#Getting_Access_to_Browser_Versionfor_Steam_Users]Activating Steam Account[/url]). 

In a few weeks we plan to make the browser version free-to-play as well with subscritpion-based Premium access.

Fore more details and answers about in-apps and free Tabletopia, see our [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/free-tabletopia-on-steam-in-apps]special article on blog[/url].

http://store.steampowered.com/app/402560
