notes.title: Lobby 2.0 is Now Live
notes.content:
Meet the new game lobby on Tabletopia: crisp, friendly, more easy to handle, and with several new and updated features! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/1952ac95b70337b185050912879b99983358a049.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New and Revamped Features:[/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]New design and look:[/b] Lobby 2.0 is more simple, friendly and easy to understand and manage.
[*]I[b]nvite players:[/b] You can now invite not only your Tabletopia friends but also other users who have experience playing this game. Also, don’t forget that you can invite people who don’t have Tabletopia accounts: share the link/room number with them. It’s free.
[*][b]Game status:[/b] The process of gathering players for the game is now more clear.
[*][b]Switch game:[/b] You can now switch to another game without even leaving the lobby! Hover the cursor over the game box and click [b]Switch[/b], then select a new game.
[*][b]Private/public room:[/b] Making the room visible or invisible to other players in Find & Play is now also more intuitive. Private rooms are not shown in Find & Play.
[*][b]Spectators:[/b] Players who enter the room but do not take seats, are displayed as Spectators.
[*][b]Custom background (Premium):[/b] Premium users can change the background image of the rooms they create. Click the [b]Settings[/b] icon to access this and other room settings.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/0dd7d78bad1af137ec10792315264fd0ed5f758c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Features Planned for Future:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]More room settings: Allowing other players to invite players, manage game flow and seats, etc.
[*]Appropriate setup: When switching the game, the system will select the setup most appropriate for the number of players in the room.
[*]Further player statuses enhancements.
[*]Further design tweaks, improvements, and some other features.[/list]
 
We really hope you like our new lobby. Happy gaming and see you at the table!

notes.title: Tabletopia Tech Update: November 10
notes.content:
Hi Tabletopians,

The latest technical update brings a few fixes to Tabletopia.

[h1][b]Features:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Users who registered through Steam or their social network accounts can now create Tabletopia login/password in their profile.[/list]

[h1][b]Bugs Fixed:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Synchronization errors in game client. Due to unstable connection the board and other game components were sometimes displayed differently to different players during the game.
[*]After activating an invite code and logging in through social media, demo users needed to re-login to access Workshop. Otherwise it was not accessible.
[*]Wrong password alert was not displayed in the login form in Firefox.
[*]Performance and overall improvements.[/list]

notes.title: All Hail Odin!
notes.content:
Who will become the new Jarl? Who will rule in the name of Odin? Find out now in [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/in-the-name-of-odin]In the Name of Odin[/url] a new games by NSKN Legendary games that has joined our catalog.

Read the [url=http://blog.tabletopia.com/nsks-legendary-interview/]interview with the NSKN Legendary games[/url] where they talk about this game, their future plans and the games they're brining to Essen this weekend!


[h1][b]In the Name of Odin[/b][/h1]
2–5 Players; 45–60 Min; 2016; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/184700/name-odin]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]In the Name of Odin[/i] is a strategy game for 2-5 players with hand management and set collection mechanics.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/3e14860686520318155dbaf3ddf2de2b53403755.jpg[/img]

As brave warriors, shrewd traders and bold explorers, you will compete to become the new Jarl. You will construct buildings in your village, gather companions, recruit famous Vikings, and build longships that will carry you to fame and glory!

[quote=Rahdo]Of all the Viking games I played so far, this one is probably my favourite. [/quote]

notes.title: Go Nuts for Donuts!
notes.content:
I love donuts! Do you love donuts? Do you want free donuts? Then [url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/go-nuts-for-donuts]Go Nuts for Donuts![/url], the delicious new addition to our catalog that is now free to play, will definitely be to your taste.

Treat yourself and hurry up to grab your copy, the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/dailymagicgames/go-nuts-for-donuts-0]game's Kickstarter campaign[/url] is almost over!
 
[h1][url=https://beta.tabletopia.com/games/go-nuts-for-donuts][b]Go Nuts for Donuts![/b][/url][/h1]
2–6 Players; 20–30 Min; 2016; [url=https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/184346/go-nuts-donuts]Game on BGG[/url]

[i]Go Nuts for Donuts![/i] is a fast-paced card game for the whole family with just a sprinkle of strategy.
 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/a12aac6e76b45b04f5893cfc9c8430670c524130.jpg[/img]

During the game you will be playing cards to pick the donuts you want, but if someone else picks the same donut then no one gets it. Choose your donuts wisely, collect sets and pairs, unique and powerful donuts, and see if you can get the most points!

[quote=Geek Dad]"Go Nuts for Donuts! is a real treat. The artwork is delicious, the gameplay is a snap to teach." [/quote]

notes.title: Adding Game Results Made Available!
notes.content:
All hail the winners! With our newest final scoring feature you will now be able to determine the winners at the end of each game and congratulate them with a proper celebration.


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/eb4c75715692ca952bac543ec2e59aaa2659dea2.jpg[/img]

 
[b]How does it work?[/b]

[list] 
[*]After you finish playing, the host of the room must [b]select Finish from the game menu[/b] (click Tabletopia logo in the top left corner of the game room > Finish).   

[*]The host then will be able to [b]determine the game outcome[/b]: specify the winners, assign final scores, or choose victory or defeat depending on the kind of game you were playing.

[*]All other players will [b]see the final results[/b] once the host confirms them. The results will also be displayed in the game lobby after you leave the table.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/cf2797a402fe8ef354b2799e56d2b3d903858b6d.jpg[/img]

[b]What else?[/b]

In the game results window you will also be able to [b]add your opponents to friends[/b] right away for future games together. Just click the star next to the player’s name.
 
In future releases we plan on adding these results to your [b]personal statistics[/b] and making [b]sharing the results on social networks[/b] available. Stay tuned!
 
Happy gaming and see you at the table!

notes.title: Smart Suggestions Are Live
notes.content:
Meet the live smart suggestions on Tabletopia! The new system helps you play more games with people currently online by suggesting you games most likely to interest you all.
 
[h1]How does it work?[/h1]

While you browse Tabletopia, our suggestions system analyzes the games you bookmarked and play most on Tabletopia and compares them to those of other players online. The system tries to find games that are likely to interest as many players now online as possible.

[img]https://beta.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/447/nmATMK9XI4BeGwvzi7Oea7.jpg[/img]
From time to time it sends you a suggestion to play a game online based on the data it gathered. If you accept, it will then proceed to searching for opponents for you. Once the required number of players accept the suggestion, the game starts automatically.
 
We hope that the new feature will make it easier for you to find opponents and play more games on Tabletopia. Be sure to bookmark all games that you’re interested in, so we can arrange more games for you!

tags.feature: Meet the live smart suggestions on Tabletopia! The new system helps you play more games with people currently online by suggesting you games most likely to interest you all.

notes.title: Play & Learn: Free Live Event on Tabletopia!
notes.content:
Want to play board games but don’t have the time to learn the rules? Want to meet other tabletop enthusiasts online? Great news for you then!

[url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/BM69AH][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/9d69e5c13b5d884bbae9278848722cb7f8afbbc4.png[/img][/url]


We are glad to announce the first [b]free live game demonstration[/b] on Tabletopia! We’ll be teaching rules and showing how to play [i][b]Santorini[/b][/i] and [i][b]Eight-Minute Empire: Legends[/b][/i].

[list]
[*]Date and time [i]Santorini[/i]: [b]07-17-2016 at 3PM (UTC)[/b]
[*]Date and time [i]Eight-Minute Empire: Legends[/i]: [b]07-19-2016 at 7PM (UTC)[/b]
[/list]

Join us at the announced time, listen to the rules and play the game right away with other players and Tabletopia game masters. 

Sounds interesting? [b][url=https://tabletopia.typeform.com/to/BM69AH]REGISTER NOW[/url][/b]
 

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/06e8f598538c9a444c8eb83ebdbbdf6d00a77fcc.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/d783749116fe717febcc317cad792004af261576.png[/img][/url]

Our game masters Ivan and Vlad will be there live to answer your questions and help with any issues. Join us, it will be fun!


[i]The event is currently for Тabletopia users only. We’re working on making these events open to everyone.[/i]

tags.feature: We are glad to announce the first [b]free live game demonstration[/b] on Tabletopia!

notes.title: Ready Check Feature Added to Tabletopia
notes.content:
[img]https://beta.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/423/osz1bozH9xz0gr8SbNvUIK.jpg?width=1240&height=822&scale=both&format=png&bgcolor=transparent[/img]

Today we are releasing the “ready check” feature on Tabletopia. This feature will let players check in for the game before it begins as well as allow for synchronizing the start of the game for all players.[b][b] [/b][/b]

Once the game host starts the game, the pre-game lobby will appear where players will be able to check ready and see the statuses of other players. During the 5 minutes before the game begins all players need to set their status to Ready, otherwise the game will not start.

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/423/M0VPZrMUP3ELXEcoHEN953.jpg[/img]

[b]The host can:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Start the game at once, before other players check Ready[/*]
 	[*]Cancel the start of the game[/*]
[/list]
[b]Other players can:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Set their status to Ready[/*]
 	[*]Leave the game, if they are not ready to play now[/*]
[/list]
The game will begin automatically once all players set their status to Ready. If any players choose to leave the game, the game host will be able to change the setup and continue with the game or cancel its start.

notes.title: Meet Your New Tabletopia Profile
notes.content:
Today we have rolled out the improved profile on Tabletopia. The main changes include the new look and the ability to edit your personal details. Also, from now on you will be able to manage your profile directly in Playground.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11995444/bdfaa1adfb58d9c5aef8ac315ca53db6cb6a737a.jpg[/img]

With the new Tabletopia profile you can:
[list]
    [*]Change your personal details, such as your photo, name, country and city, spoken languages, etc. 
    [*]View and manage new information and statistics, such as: last game you played, the games you play most, your active rooms, recommended and bookmarked games, etc.
    [*]Add and manage social network profiles for an easier way to log in (available for the website version only).
    [*]Send personal messages (website version only).
    [*]Change your password (website version only).
[/list]

We hope that starting today, it will be even easier to express yourself on Tabletopia through a new and improved profile as well as find people to play with according to their experience and preferences.

notes.title: Games for this weekend No20
notes.content:
Weekly digest of new Tabletopia games

[H1]1. Terra Mystica and Fire & Ice expansion[/H1]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/389/8Aj3xqKMXiHok0J21TJPT2.jpg[/img]

Terra Mystica is a game with very little luck that rewards strategic planning. Each player governs one of the 14 groups. With subtlety and craft, the player must attempt to rule as great an area as possible and to develop that group's skills. There are also four religious cults in which you can progress. To do all that, each group has special skills and abilities.

Now all the 14 races are available in the base game. We have also updated the visuals and intergrated a new surface instead of the old simple table. Last but not least, you can try out Fire & Ice expansion or the game with promo components!

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 2 − 5
[b]Playing time[/b]: 60 − 150 min.
[b]Suggested age[/b]: 12+

[H1]2. Waste Knights[/H1]

[img]https://beta.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/389/TpAy2mOimgsWHPlITss4D7.jpg[/img]

Waste Knights is a post-apocalyptic adventure game for 2-4 players set in dystopian Australia now called the Waste. Each player becomes a hero who travels around the continent fighting monstrous enemies, accomplishing Tasks to acquire new Gear Cards and hoping to gain enough Reputation in order to fulfill the Mission being played. All players share a common goal set by the Mission, but only the quickest and the most cunning will manage to win!

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 2 − 4
[b]Playing time[/b]: 90 − 240 min.
[b]Suggested age[/b]: 16+

[H1]3. Flag-Bearer[/H1]

[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/389/ZeYMrHUTzvjZFK9lhJaeI5.jpg[/img]

Two brave armies meet in a battle. Each army has 20 different warriors, which have different qualities and battle skills. You, as an experienced commander, must use them to win. Players try to annihilate three flag-bearers of the enemy and protect one of their own. The player who achieves this goal becomes the winner.

[b]Number of Players[/b]: 2
[b]Playing time[/b]: 30 min.
[b]Suggested age[/b]: 10+

notes.title: Games for this weekend No18
notes.content:
We are welcome new games become available for current testers of Tabletopia! These are two expansion for the game Keyflower. In Keyflower each player develops their own unique village over four seasons by successfully bidding for a range of village tiles (specialised buildings and boats) and collecting skills, resources and workers (‘keyples’).

1. Keyflower: The Farmers

[url=https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/367/CCMCsxYyPNFdYfZFDcL5R4.jpg][img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/367/CCMCsxYyPNFdYfZFDcL5R4.jpg[/img][/url]

In Keyflower – the Farmers, players develop the agricultural side of their economy by acquiring new farm buildings, growing wheat and collecting and breeding farm animals (cows, pigs and sheep). Animals are kept in the fields created by the layout of the roads, adding a new dimension and considerations to the base game.

Number of Players: 2 − 6
Playing time: 90 − 120 min.
Suggested age: 13+

2. Keyflower: The Merchants

[url=https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/370/DmdI4QzEvsrJnzhEJDrw56.jpg][img]https://tabletopia.r.worldssl.net/static/files/000/370/DmdI4QzEvsrJnzhEJDrw56.jpg[/img][/url]

In Keyflower – the Merchants, players continue to develop their village by building extensions and cabins, entering into lucrative contracts and encountering new combinations of items on the incoming boats.

Number of Players: 2 − 6
Playing time: 90 − 120 min.
Suggested age: 10+

notes.title: Tabletopia Update - April 8th, 2016
notes.content:
Hi all,

With the latest Tabletopia update, we’ve included the Windows 32-bit version of the Tabletopia Steam client. We have also included DirectX v.11 and some other packages to be installed if required.

Specific changes include:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
     [*]Friends: Added ability to search players by name or login
     [*]Friends: Ability to add player to your friends list from that player’s profile
     [*]Find&Play: Find&Play automatically refreshes (showing newly created rooms immediately)
[*]Find&Play: Your own private rooms are excluded from the list
[/list] 
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
     [*]Fixed: Duplicated accounts displayed in ‘Friends’ when friend has 2+ connected logins (e.g. Steam, Facebook, Google)
     [*]Fixed: For some players, 'Get Activation Code’ was displayed on login to Tabletopia Web portal
[/list]

notes.title: Games for this weekend
notes.content:
We are welcome new games become available for current testers of Tabletopia!

 
[h1][b]Automania[/b][/h1]
[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/360/k8gIWvCx39JpgmIzYz3PF0.jpg[/img]

In Automania, you run a car factory, trying to produce the most popular cars in the market. To achieve this, you buy tiles to upgrade and customize your factory, and hire specialist employees to help you.

Central to the game are the factory boards: Each player has a factory with three assembly lines, and each assembly line produces one type of car. You can put machine tiles along your assembly lines to change the specifications of your cars. However, your three assembly lines intersect, so each machine tile placed might affect more than one type of car — which means you have to think carefully about where you put those machines.


When a car is produced, it must be sold in one of two markets, and the better the specifications of the car is in line with the demand in the chosen market, the more popular the car will be. The most popular cars reap the highest profits, earning money or prestige — which is what you need to win this game.

 

[b]Number of Players:[/b] 2 − 4

[b]Playing time:[/b] 60 − 90 min.

[b]Suggested age:[/b] 12+

[b]Mechanics:[/b]  Tile Placement, Variable Player Powers, Worker Placement

[b]Theme:[/b] Cars, Industry


 
[h1][b]Artifacts Inc.[/b][/h1]
[img]https://front-eu1.tabletopia.com/static/files/000/360/z3FyyKTkXU3C4y5tbol7Lj0.jpg[/img]

New York, 1929: A frenzy of interest in antiquity is sweeping the nation! With museums hungry for mysterious and exotic artifacts — and you hungry for adventure — you start up your own archeology company. Untold wonders await within dangerous jungles, harsh deserts, and wind-swept mountains. Will you gain a reputation as the most intrepid and famous adventurer of all time?


In Artifacts, Inc. players compete to grow the most famous archeology company. Players roll dice, which represent their troop of adventurers, and place them on cards in order to find artifacts, sell them to museums, and purchase new cards representing their company assets. Players can choose to focus on making lots of money by selling artifacts, having museum majorities, creating the best combination of expeditions and buildings, or searching below the waves for lost cities and hidden treasures. The first player to reach 20 reputation triggers the end of the game, and the player with the most total reputation wins!

 

[b]Number of Players:[/b] 2 − 4

[b]Playing time:[/b] 60 min.

[b]Suggested age:[/b] 13+

[b]Mechanics:[/b] Action Point Allowance System, Area Control / Area Influence, Card Drafting, Dice Rolling, Set Collection

[b]Theme:[/b] Archaeology
